Ability_stench_Effect:
This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect.
This ability does not stack with a held item.
Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.
Ability_voltabsorb_Effect:
Whenever an electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it.
This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves.  Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's substitute.
This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. thunder wave.
Ability_stall_Effect:
This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket.
Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves.
The full incense and lagging tail take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability.  Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item.
This ability works as usual during trick room: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.
Ability_stall_Flavor:
The Pokémon moves after
even slower foes.
Ability_technician_Effect:
This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less.
This includes moves of variable power, such as hidden power and magnitude, when their power is 60 or less.  helping hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is defense curl's power boost for rollout.
Ability_technician_Flavor:
Powers up the Pokémon’s
weaker moves.
Ability_leafguard_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight.
This ability does not heal prior status ailments.  rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect.  yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.
Ability_leafguard_Flavor:
Prevents status problems
in sunny weather.
Ability_klutz_Effect:
In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative.  This Pokémon also cannot use fling.
The Speed cut from the iron ball and the effort items (the macho brace, power weight, power bracer, power belt, power lens, power band, and power anklet) is unaffected.  Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the exp share, the amulet coin, or the soothe bell, work as usual.  All held items work as usual out of battle.
Other moves that use the held item, such as natural gift and switcheroo, work as usual.
Ability_klutz_Flavor:
The Pokémon can’t use
any held items.
Ability_moldbreaker_Effect:
This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target.
For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as water absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as clear body, shell armor, or sticky hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as simple, snow cloak, or thick fat.  If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. dry skin or unaware, the ability is ignored either way.
Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected.  For example, cursed body only affects potential future uses of the move, while liquid ooze and shadow tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user.  This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example color change or forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from drizzle.  This ability cannot ignore multitype at all.
An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used.  For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed.
When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.
This ability functions identically to teravolt and turboblaze.
Ability_moldbreaker_Flavor:
Moves can be used
regardless of abilities.
Ability_superluck_Effect: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.
Ability_superluck_Flavor:
Heightens the critical-hit
ratios of moves.
Ability_aftermath_Effect: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.
Ability_aftermath_Flavor:
Damages the foe landing
the finishing hit.
Ability_anticipation_Effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, self destruct, explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified.
The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move.  Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as future sight, and moves of variable type, such as hidden power, count as their listed types.  counter, metal burst, mirror coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.
Ability_forewarn_Effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers.
In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random.
Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows:
Power | Moves
----: | -----
  160 | One-hit KO moves: fissure, guillotine, horn drill, and sheer cold
  120 | Counter moves: counter, metal burst, and mirror coat
   80 | Variable power or set damage: crush grip, dragon rage, electro ball, endeavor, final gambit, flail, frustration, grass knot, gyro ball, heat crash, heavy slam, hidden power, low kick, natural gift, night shade, psywave, return, reversal, seismic toss, sonic boom, trump card, and wring out
    0 | Any such move not listed
Ability_forewarn_Flavor:
Determines what moves
the foe has.
Ability_unaware_Effect:
This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation.
Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed.
The power of punishment and stored power is calculated as usual.  When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.
Ability_unaware_Flavor:
Ignores any change in
ability by the foe.
Ability_waterabsorb_Effect:
Whenever a water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it.
Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's substitute.
Ability_waterabsorb_Flavor:
Restores HP if hit by a
Water-type move.
Ability_tintedlens_Effect: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.
Ability_filter_Effect:
This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it.
This ability functions identically to solid rock.

This Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved for five turns upon entering battle.
This ability also takes effect when acquired during battle.  If this Pokémon loses its ability before the five turns are up, its Attack and Speed return to normal; if it then regains this ability without leaving battle, its Attack and Speed are halved again, but the counter keeps counting from where it was.
Ability_scrappy_Effect:
This Pokémon ignores ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to normal- and fighting-type moves.
Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.
Ability_scrappy_Flavor:
Enables moves to hit
Ghost-type foes.

All other Pokémon's single-target water-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon, if it is an eligible target.  Other Pokémon's Water moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it.
If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected.  When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon.  follow me takes precedence over this ability.
Ability_stormdrain_Flavor:
The Pokémon draws in all
Water-type moves.

The Pokémon regains HP in
a hailstorm.
Ability_solidrock_Effect:
This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it.

The weather changes to hail when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
Ability_snowwarning_Flavor:
The Pokémon summons a
hailstorm in battle.
Ability_honeygather_Effect:
This Pokémon has a chance of picking up honey after each battle.  This chance starts at 5% and rises another 5% after every tenth level: 5% from level 1–10, 10% from 11–20, and so on, up to 50% from 91–100.

Ability_honeygather_Flavor:
The Pokémon may gather
Honey from somewhere.

When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers.

Ability_frisk_Flavor:
The Pokémon can check

Ability_oblivious_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to captivate.

This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power.
struggle is unaffected.

Ability_reckless_Flavor:
Powers up moves that

Ability_multitype_Effect:
If this Pokémon is holding an elemental Plate, its type and form change to match the Plate.
This Pokémon's held item, whether or not it is a Plate, cannot be taken by covet or thief, nor removed by knock off, nor traded by switcheroo or trick.  Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon.  Unlike with sticky hold, this Pokémon cannot use fling, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one.
This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than arceus.  This ability cannot be traded with skill swap, nor copied with role play or trace, nor disabled with gastro acid, nor changed with worry seed.  This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself.  mold breaker cannot ignore this ability.
If a Pokémon Transforms into an Arceus with this ability, it will Transform into Arceus's default, normal-type form.  If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.

Changes type to match
the held Plate.

Friendly Pokémon have 1.5× their Attack and Special Defense during strong sunlight if any friendly Pokémon has this ability.

Ability_flowergift_Flavor:
Powers up party Pokémon

Ability_baddreams_Effect: Opposing Pokémon take 1/8 of their maximum HP in damage after each turn while they are asleep.

Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, if it does not have a held item, it steals the attacker's held item.

Ability_pickpocket_Flavor:
Steals an item when hit

This Pokémon's moves with extra effects have 1.3× their power, but lose their extra effects.

Ability_sheerforce_Flavor:
Removes added effects to

While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects.

May disable a move used

May heal an ally’s status

All friendly Pokémon take 0.75× as much direct damage from moves while this Pokémon is in battle.

Ability_harvest_Flavor:
May create another
Berry after one is used.

This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy.

Defense-lowering attacks.

Ability_tabletsofruin_Effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Ability_tabletsofruin_Flavor: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Ability_beadsofruin_Effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Ability_beadsofruin_Flavor: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Ability_orichalcumpulse_Effect: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
Ability_orichalcumpulse_Flavor: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
Ability_hadronengine_Effect: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
Ability_hadronengine_Flavor: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
Ability_clearbody_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon.
This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis.  This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through guard swap, heart swap, or power swap.
This ability functions identically to white smoke in battle.
Ability_opportunist_Effect: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
Ability_opportunist_Flavor: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
Ability_cudchew_Effect: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
Ability_cudchew_Flavor: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
Ability_sharpness_Effect: Increases the power of all 'slicing' moves by 50%.
Ability_supremeoverlord_Effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
Ability_supremeoverlord_Flavor: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
Ability_costar_Effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s stat changes.
Ability_costar_Flavor: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.
Ability_toxicdebris_Effect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
Ability_toxicdebris_Flavor: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
Ability_armortail_Effect: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
Ability_armortail_Flavor: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
Ability_eartheater_Effect: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Ability_eartheater_Flavor: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Ability_myceliummight_Effect: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
Ability_myceliummight_Flavor: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
Ability_mindseye_Effect: Mind's Eye enables the Pokémon with this Ability to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with damage-dealing Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It also prevents other Pokémon from lowering the Pokémon's accuracy and ignores changes to the opponents' evasion.
Ability_mindseye_Flavor: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves
Ability_speedboost_Effect: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.
Ability_naturalcure_Effect:
This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon.
If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.
Ability_supersweetsyrup_Effect: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.
Ability_supersweetsyrup_Flavor: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle
Ability_hospitality_Effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.
Ability_hospitality_Flavor: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP
Ability_toxicchain_Effect: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.
Ability_toxicchain_Flavor: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move
Ability_embodyaspect_Effect: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon
Ability_embodyaspect_Flavor: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.
Ability_terashift_Effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
Ability_terashift_Flavor: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
Ability_terashell_Effect: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
Ability_terashell_Flavor: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
Ability_teraformzero_Effect: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
Ability_teraformzero_Flavor: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
Ability_poisonpuppeteer_Effect: When a Pokémon is poisoned by any of Pecharunt's moves, it will also become confused.
Ability_poisonpuppeteer_Flavor: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
Ability_lightningrod_Effect:
All other Pokémon's single-target electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target.  Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it.
If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected.  When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon.  follow me takes precedence over this ability.
If the Pokémon is a ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.
Ability_serenegrace_Effect:
This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance.
An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect.  For example, flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but protect's chance of success and air cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected.
secret power is unaffected.
Ability_swiftswim_Effect:
This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain.
This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
Ability_chlorophyll_Effect:
This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight.
This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
Ability_illuminate_Effect:
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
This ability has no effect in battle.
Ability_trace_Effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability.
This ability cannot copy flower gift, forecast, illusion, imposter, multitype, trace, wonder guard, or zen mode.
Ability_hugepower_Effect:
This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle.
This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
This ability functions identically to pure power.
Ability_poisonpoint_Effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.
Ability_battlearmor_Effect:
Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon.
This ability functions identically to shell armor.
Ability_magmaarmor_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot be frozen.
If a Pokémon is frozen and acquires this ability, it will immediately thaw out; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly.  This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or flame body.
Ability_waterveil_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot be burned.
If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
Ability_magnetpull_Effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out.
Pokémon with run away can still flee.  Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.
Ability_soundproof_Effect:
This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based.
heal bell is unaffected.  uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping.  This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through baton pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used.
howl, roar of time, sonic boom, and yawn are not flagged as sound-based.
Ability_raindish_Effect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.
Ability_sandstream_Effect:
The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.
If multiple Pokémon with this ability, drizzle, drought, or snow warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting trick room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.
Ability_pressure_Effect:
Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP.
This ability stacks if multiple targets have it.  This ability still affects moves that fail or miss.  This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field.  If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP.
When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
Ability_thickfat_Effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from fire- and ice-type moves.
Ability_earlybird_Effect:
This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1.
If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.
Ability_flamebody_Effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned.
Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly.  This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or magma armor.
Ability_sturdy_Effect:
When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP.  Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: fissure, guillotine, horn drill, and sheer cold.
If this Pokémon is holding a focus sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.
Ability_runaway_Effect: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.
Ability_keeneye_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered.
This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate.  This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through heart swap.
Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
Ability_hypercutter_Effect:
This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon.
This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn.  This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through heart swap or power swap.
Ability_pickup_Effect:
At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one.  After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one.
The air balloon and eject button cannot be picked up.
The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level.  This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.
Ability_truant_Effect:
Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around").
Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do.  Most such moves, for example bide or rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around.  Attacks with a recharge turn, such as hyper beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as fly, do not end up being used.  Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as outrage, uproar, or any move forced by encore, keep going as usual.
If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending.
If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn.  If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did.
This ability cannot be changed with worry seed, but it can be disabled with gastro acid, changed with role play, or traded away with skill swap.
Ability_hustle_Effect:
This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy.
Special moves are unaffected.  Moves that do set damage, such as seismic toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
Ability_cutecharm_Effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated.
Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.
Ability_plus_Effect:
This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has plus or minus.
This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.  If either ability is disabled by gastro acid, both lose their effect.
Ability_minus_Effect:
This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has plus or minus.
This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.  If either ability is disabled by gastro acid, both lose their effect.
Ability_forecast_Effect:
During rain, strong sunlight, or hail, this Pokémon's type changes to water, fire, or ice, respectively, and its form changes to match.
This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than castform.
If the weather ends or becomes anything that does not trigger this ability, or a Pokémon with air lock or cloud nine enters battle, this Pokémon's type and form revert to their default.  If this ability is lost or disabled, this Pokémon cannot change its current type and form until it regains its ability.
Ability_damp_Effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, self destruct and explosion will fail and aftermath will not take effect.
Ability_stickyhold_Effect:
This Pokémon's hold item cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
Damaging moves that would remove this Pokémon's item can still inflict damage against this Pokémon, e.g. knock off or pluck.  This Pokémon can still use moves that involve the loss of its own item, e.g. fling or trick.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the encounter rate while fishing is increased.
Ability_shedskin_Effect: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.
Ability_guts_Effect:
Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack.  This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn.
This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
Ability_marvelscale_Effect:
Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Defense.
This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
Ability_liquidooze_Effect:
Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like absorb, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain.
dream eater is unaffected.
Ability_overgrow_Effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
Ability_overgrow_Flavor:
Powers up Grass-type
moves in a pinch.
Ability_blaze_Effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
Ability_blaze_Flavor: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.
Ability_torrent_Effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
Ability_torrent_Flavor: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.
Ability_swarm_Effect:
When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.
Ability_swarm_Flavor: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.
Ability_rockhead_Effect:
This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves.
struggle's recoil is unaffected.  This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with jump kick or high jump kick.
Ability_rockhead_Flavor: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
Ability_limber_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed.
If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
Ability_drought_Effect:
The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.
If multiple Pokémon with this ability, drizzle, sand stream, or snow warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting trick room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
Ability_arenatrap_Effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out.  flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to levitate or magnet rise, are unaffected.
Pokémon with run away can still flee.  Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
Ability_vitalspirit_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot be asleep.
This causes rest to fail altogether.  If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
This ability functions identically to insomnia in battle.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
Ability_whitesmoke_Effect:
This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon.
This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis; nor self-inflicted stat drops, such as the Special Attack drop from overheat; nor opponent-triggered stat boosts, such as the Attack boost from swagger.  This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through guard swap, heart swap, or power swap.
This ability functions identically to clear body in battle.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.
Ability_purepower_Effect:
This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle.
This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
This ability functions identically to huge power.
Ability_shellarmor_Effect:
Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon.
This ability functions identically to battle armor.
Ability_airlock_Effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects.
This ability functions identically to cloud nine.
Ability_tangledfeet_Effect: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.
Ability_tangledfeet_Flavor:
Raises evasion if the
Pokémon is confused.
Ability_motordrive_Effect:
Whenever an electric-type move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage, negating any other effect on it.
This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is immune to Electric moves.  Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's substitute.
This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. thunder wave.
Ability_motordrive_Flavor:
Raises Speed if hit by an
Electric-type move.
Ability_rivalry_Effect:
This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender.
If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.
Ability_rivalry_Flavor:
Raises Attack if the foe
is of the same gender.
Ability_sandveil_Effect:
During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type.
The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.
Ability_steadfast_Effect: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.
Ability_steadfast_Flavor:
Raises Speed each time
the Pokémon flinches.
Ability_snowcloak_Effect:
During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.
The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.
Ability_gluttony_Effect: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.
Ability_gluttony_Flavor:
Encourages the early use
of a held Berry.
Ability_angerpoint_Effect:
Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages.
This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a substitute.
Ability_angerpoint_Flavor:
Raises Attack upon taking
a critical hit.
Ability_unburden_Effect:
When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled.  If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost.
This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of knock off.  This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.  There is no notification when this ability takes effect.
Ability_unburden_Flavor:
Raises Speed if a held
item is used.
Ability_heatproof_Effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from fire-type moves and burns.
Ability_heatproof_Flavor:
Weakens the power of
Fire-type moves.
Ability_simple_Effect:
Each stage of this Pokémon's stat modifiers acts as two stages.  These doubled stages are still limited to a minimum of -6 and a maximum of 6.
This Pokémon can still accumulate less than -3 or more than 3 stages of stat modifiers, even though the extra ones have no effect after doubling.
Ability_simple_Flavor:
The Pokémon is prone to
wild stat changes.
Ability_dryskin_Effect: This Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn during strong sunlight, but it heals for 1/8 of its HP each turn during rain.  This Pokémon takes 1.25× as much damage from fire-type moves, but whenever a water move hits it, it heals for 1/4 its maximum HP instead.
Ability_dryskin_Flavor:
Reduces HP if it is hot.
Water restores HP.
Ability_download_Effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, its Attack or Special Attack, whichever corresponds to its opponents' weaker total defensive stat, rises one stage.  In the event of a tie, Special Attack is raised.
This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle.
Ability_download_Flavor:
Adjusts power according
to the foe’s ability.
Ability_ironfist_Effect:
Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon.
sucker punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".
Ability_ironfist_Flavor:
Boosts the power of
punching moves.
Ability_static_Effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed.
Pokémon that are immune to electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an electric Pokémon, if applicable.
Ability_poisonheal_Effect: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage.  This includes bad poison.
Ability_poisonheal_Flavor:
Restores HP if the
Pokémon is poisoned.
Ability_adaptability_Effect: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.
Ability_adaptability_Flavor:
Powers up moves of the
same type.
Ability_skilllink_Effect: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as icicle spear.  It also bypasses the accuracy checks on triple kick's second and third hits.
Ability_skilllink_Flavor:
Increases the frequency
of multi-strike moves.
Ability_hydration_Effect: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
Ability_hydration_Flavor:
Heals status problems if
it is raining.
Ability_solarpower_Effect: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.
Ability_solarpower_Flavor:
Boosts Sp. Atk, but
lowers HP in sunshine.
Ability_quickfeet_Effect:
Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed.  This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.
Ability_quickfeet_Flavor:
Boosts Speed if there is a
status problem.
Ability_normalize_Effect:
This Pokémon's moves all act as if they were normal-type.
Moves that inflict typeless damage do so as usual.  Moves of variable type, such as hidden power, are affected.  They otherwise work as usual, however; weather ball, for example, is always forced to be Normal, but it still has doubled power and looks different during weather.
As thunder wave is prevented by immunities, unlike most non-damaging moves, it does not affect ghost-type Pokémon under the effect of this ability.
Ability_normalize_Flavor:
All the Pokémon’s moves
become the Normal type.
Ability_sniper_Effect: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.
Ability_sniper_Flavor:
Powers up moves if they
become critical hits.
Ability_magicguard_Effect:
This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move.
For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a life orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it.  Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, leech seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a jaboca berry or rowap berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon.
The following are unaffected: struggle, pain split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), belly drum, substitute, curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion.
This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with liquid ooze.
If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.
Ability_magicguard_Flavor:
The Pokémon only takes
damage from attacks.
Ability_noguard_Effect:
Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss.
One-hit KO moves are unaffected.  Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like dig or fly.
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
Ability_noguard_Flavor:
Ensures the Pokémon and
its foe’s attacks land.
Species_abra_Description: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.
Species_aerodactyl_Description: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.
Species_alakazam_Description: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.
Species_arbok_Description: A deadly predator found in warm, dry areas, Arbok terrifies its prey with the pattern on its chest before constricting them. The pattern seems to vary between individuals, and more than eight different sets of markings have been discovered to date. One particularly frightening pattern is found in Arbok who make their homes within the wastes of the Nether, where a consistent source of warmth allows them to move with exceptional speed and precision.
Species_arcanine_Description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
Species_articuno_Description: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.
Species_beedrill_Description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
Species_bellsprout_Description: A diurnal plant-like Pokémon that inhabits humid environments where water and sunlight are plentiful. Bellsprout plants its rooted feet in the ground and camouflages itself as a flower while it rests, expertly attracting and capturing its prey by quickly ensnaring them with its vines and swiftly digesting them with corrosive fluid.
Species_blastoise_Description: The cannon-like structures on this Pokémon’s shell are composed of specialized bones that can shoot powerful jets of water. These water bolts are capable of punching through solid iron, even from across the sea. While its cannons make Blastoise a force to be reckoned with, it tends to avoid humans, preferring to oversee groups of Squirtle and Wartortle on distant, uninhabited islands.
Species_bulbasaur_Description: While rare and elusive in the wild, Bulbasaur’s calm and easygoing nature makes it a popular choice for beginning trainers. The bud on its back is still developing, so this Pokémon must expend large amounts of energy to fuel its growth. As a result, it is often seen rummaging through composters in search of precious fertilizer.
Species_butterfree_Description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
Species_caterpie_Description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
Species_chansey_Description: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.
Species_charizard_Description: With the experience of countless battles, Charmeleon has evolved into Charizard, a ferocious Pokémon adept at both aerial and grounded combat. Held aloft by its powerful wings, it soars inside the caverns of the Nether, searching for worthy foes. When Charizard grows weary from its many battles, it bathes in a pool of molten lava, a behavior which seems to aid in the process of healing and relaxation.
Species_charmander_Description: While a popular first partner for trainers, Charmander’s fiery and energetic personality can make it challenging to work with. The flame on its tail is a measure of its life force, and this Pokémon will perish if it is ever extinguished, so it must be protected at all costs. It thrives within the scorching wastes of the Nether, where no water can threaten its flame.
Species_charmeleon_Description: Possessing a quick temper and a fiery spirit, Charmeleon is constantly challenging stronger opponents to improve its mastery over flame. When it finds itself matched up against a particularly powerful enemy, the fire on its tail shines brightly, and its powers reach their zenith. In this state, it is capable of releasing great gouts of flame to scorch everything around it.
Species_clefable_Description: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.
Species_clefairy_Description: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.
Species_cloyster_Description: Cloyster's adaptation to colder waters has strengthened its shell, forming a layer of armor that is nearly impenetrable when fully closed. Over time, impacts on its surface stimulate the growth of icy, pointed spikes, which can either be used to defend against persistent threats or launched like spears at fleeing prey. Remarkably, even when it can't see, Cloyster demonstrates exceptional aim, rarely missing its mark.
Species_cubone_Description: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.
Species_dewgong_Description: Dewgong has fully adapted to the glacial biomes it inhabits, featuring a pure white coat that camouflages it in snow, an omnivorous diet including seagrass and seabed scraps, and an increase in blubber to protect against freezing temperatures. However, this adaptation has made it vulnerable outside its native environment, as it struggles to survive in warmer or human-inhabited climates. Some towns have even enacted laws prohibiting anyone from touching Dewgong in an effort to protect the species.
Species_diglett_Description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
Species_ditto_Description: A peculiar species, Ditto are capable of rapidly reconstituting their body structure to mimic that of anything they can see. Studies conclude that certain specimens excel in specific aspects of transformation, while others fall short in some areas, as every Ditto is unique in their own way. This transformation ability is not limited to Pokémon; some individuals have been observed to mimic nearby blocks to camouflage while sleeping. However, if Ditto attempt to mimic something from memory, or while laughing, the duplicate will have certain details incorrect or omitted entirely.
Species_dodrio_Description: One of Doduo's two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.
Species_doduo_Description: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.
Species_dragonair_Description: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.
Species_dragonite_Description: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.
Species_dratini_Description: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini's forehead is actually a horn that's still coming in.
Species_drowzee_Description: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.
Species_dugtrio_Description: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
Species_eevee_Description: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.
Species_ekans_Description: This Pokémon often spends its days resting in the grass to bask in the sun's warmth after a meal. When the weather gets cold, Ekans gather underground to conserve heat and group together into a ball that can consist of hundreds of individuals. When the time comes for them to exit their burrow though, escaping can be a challenge, as it is not uncommon for these Pokémon to find themselves tied together.
Species_electabuzz_Description: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.
Species_electrode_Description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
Species_exeggcute_Description: Often mistaken for a clutch of Pokémon Eggs, Exeggcute are more similar in body structure to cocoa beans. There are six "seeds" in total, they communicate and coordinate with each other using telepathy, and can reunite quickly if seperated. They use these same extrasensory powers to ward off predators.
Species_exeggutor_Description: Colloquially referred to as "The Walking Jungle", this Pokémon's three heads think independently. Though they never seem to squabble, Exeggutor often has trouble getting about from place to place when they can't decide on a single direction that they want to move in. When their brains are in sync, however, Exeggutor's combined psychic power can be devastating for any opponent to deal with.
Species_farfetchd_Description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.
Species_fearow_Description: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.
Species_flareon_Description: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
Species_gastly_Description: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.
Species_gengar_Description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
Species_geodude_Description: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.
Species_gloom_Description: Gloom's bulbous flower emits a repugnant scent that, according to rumor, can induce temporary memory loss if you stray too close. The sweet saliva-esque nectar that seeps from its mouth smells just as horrid, and it uses these rotting odors to attract its detritivore prey.
Species_golbat_Description: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.
Species_goldeen_Description: This Pokémon's long, billowing fins float elegantly behind it in the water, giving Goldeen the nickname of "the water dancer." This beauty attracts mates, but also attracts unwanted attention from rivals and predators. Goldeen may look dainty, but it's not afraid to fight back using its sharp horn.
Species_golduck_Description: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.
Species_golem_Description: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
Species_graveler_Description: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.
Species_grimer_Description: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.
Species_growlithe_Description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
Species_gyarados_Description: Every Gyarados starts its life as a pitiful Magikarp, fighting for survival in the wild. The sudden transformation from flopping prey to colossal force of destruction causes their brains to go berserk; after evolving, Gyarados crave little more than destruction and ash.
Species_haunter_Description: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.
Species_hitmonchan_Description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
Species_hitmonlee_Description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
Species_horsea_Description: Horsea has poor endurance and is only capable of swimming in short bursts, so it clings to bits of kelp or coral to keep itself from being swept away by the current. If threatened by a predator, it shoots a stream of ink and escapes while the target is blinded. It is highly skilled with these shots, and can also use them to knock small bug Pokémon out of the air to eat.
Species_hypno_Description: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
Species_ivysaur_Description: The small bud it had as a Bulbasaur has become more developed with evolution. It still requires copious amounts of energy, so Ivysaur spends much of its time basking in the sun. As the bud matures, it begins to emit a pleasant scent, attracting Bug-type Pokémon that follow it wherever it goes. In this way, Ivysaur encourages pollination, helping to keep the forest lush and healthy.
Species_jigglypuff_Description: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.
Species_jolteon_Description: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.
Species_jynx_Description: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.
Species_kabuto_Description: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.
Species_kabutops_Description: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.
Species_kadabra_Description: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.
Species_kakuna_Description: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.
Species_kangaskhan_Description: Powerfully built and covered in thick armored plating, Kangaskhan is a force to be reckoned with, especially when protecting its young. It raises its child in a special pouch, keeping it warm and safe from predators. Although the juvenile must eventually set out into the world to have its own children, the act of a baby Kangaskhan actually leaving its mother's pouch is undocumented.
Species_kingler_Description: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
Species_koffing_Description: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.
Species_krabby_Description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
Species_lapras_Description: Schools of these gentle Pokémon travel to tropical waters to mate and raise their young before returning to the glacial seas where they make their homes. Lapras are highly intelligent, and their calls are believed to be a complex form of communication. Due to their docile nature, they are often used as transportation in coastal settlements.
Species_lickitung_Description: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.
Species_machamp_Description: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.
Species_machoke_Description: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.
Species_machop_Description: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.
Species_magikarp_Description: Whilst weak and pathetic in battle, Magikarp are heavily sought-after in certain high society groups. Their rare varieties of colors and patterns each have their own symbolism and meanings to aficionados of the species, and they all fetch a high price on the market.
Species_magmar_Description: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.
Species_magnemite_Description: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.
Species_magneton_Description: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.
Species_mankey_Description: Mankey is easily provoked and shows no signs of hesitation when attacking other Pokémon. The rest of its troop is highly influenceable, becoming furious as soon as they notice the rage of one of their members. It seems that anger is one of the only few hormonal responses it has, no matter what the situation is. As a result, it can't help but spend most of the day angry at everything around it.
Species_marowak_Description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
Species_meowth_Description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
Species_metapod_Description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.
Species_mew_Description: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon's short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
Species_mewtwo_Description: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew's. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.
Species_moltres_Description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.
Species_mr-mime_Description: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.
Species_muk_Description: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
Species_nidoking_Description: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.
Species_nidoqueen_Description: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.
Species_nidoran-f_Description: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.
Species_nidoran-m_Description: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.
Species_nidorina_Description: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.
Species_nidorino_Description: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.
Species_ninetales_Description: While extremely smart and unendingly loyal, Ninetales is said to haunt anyone it holds a grudge against, tormenting them and their descendants with phantom visions and pain. Folklore states that this vindictive Pokémon will even chase its most hated victims into the afterlife.
Species_oddish_Description: Oddish buries itself in the ground during the day to photosynthesize, storing up energy to wander around at night and spread its seeds. Pokémon researchers of the past had a hard time classifying it due to how similar its bodily structure resembles actual plant life.
Species_omanyte_Description: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.
Species_omastar_Description: Omastar's sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.
Species_onix_Description: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.
Species_paras_Description: Paras are typically born aboveground, with no signs of fungal growth on their back. However, as they age, the parasitic mushrooms grow and compel them to bury through the roots of azalea trees, soon finding themselves in the damp, lush caves beneath. This perfect environment allows both the mushroom and the bug to thrive, sometimes a little too much.
Species_parasect_Description: It prefers the dim, damp environment of lush caves, often times nestling itself in clay and moss, remaining still for days at a time. This allows the mushroom to conserve and consume the host's energy, causing it to become monstrous in size. As the mushroom grows larger, the host's nervous networks are slowly replaced with webs of neuroreceptive hyphae.
Species_persian_Description: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
Species_pidgeot_Description: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.
Species_pidgeotto_Description: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.
Species_pidgey_Description: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.
Species_pikachu_Description: Pikachu’s adorable appearance attracts many admirers, but its unpredictable temper makes it less suited for beginning trainers. When startled or annoyed, Pikachu instinctively discharges electricity from the specialized organs in its cheeks. Even trained Pikachu can react this way, so caution is advised. When large groups of Pikachu gather, the collective electric charge in the air is strong enough to create thunderstorms.
Species_pinsir_Description: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.
Species_poliwag_Description: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.
Species_poliwhirl_Description: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.
Species_poliwrath_Description: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.
Species_ponyta_Description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.
Species_porygon_Description: This Pokémon is strange, to say the least. Evidently it isn't natural, as it has no need for air or food. While this makes Porygon a prime candidate for exploration of some of this world's extra-ordinary locations, it would be wise to gain a better understanding of the Pokémon beforehand. There are distinct similarities between it and PC technology, but their relationship is, as of yet, unknown.
Species_primeape_Description: Primeape spends most of its daily life in a constant state of simmering anger. When riled up, its anger will boil over; blood circulation increases, adrenaline spikes, and intelligence drops to the floor. This behavior is often exploited by other Pokémon, as Primeape becomes very easy to trick. This puts its life in peril as it becomes careless about its surroundings and actions. It doesn't feel any pain while enraged, so it often runs the risk of putting its body through levels of stress that it cannot handle.
Species_psyduck_Description: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.
Species_raichu_Description: Raichu’s electrical abilities become much stronger upon evolution, but it often struggles to regulate this increased power. When too much electricity builds up, Raichu may become stressed, causing it to act violently and unpredictably. To relieve this pressure, it sinks its tail into the ground to safely discharge excess energy. Many trainers avoid evolving their Pikachu due to Raichu’s reputation, but those that do learn to understand its need for regular energy release.
Species_rapidash_Description: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.
Species_raticate_Description: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
Species_rattata_Description: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.
Species_rhydon_Description: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.
Species_rhyhorn_Description: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.
Species_sandshrew_Description: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
Species_sandslash_Description: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
Species_scyther_Description: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
Species_seadra_Description: Unlike Horsea, few predators are willing to threaten Seadra. Its fins are tipped with venomous spines, and it can spew water from its snout at incredibly high pressure. They are very attentive fathers, with males caring for their eggs and protecting the young after they hatch.
Species_seaking_Description: Despite their elegant appearances, Seaking are in fact powerful swimmers, and have been observed swimming against strong streams and currents to reach the river basin they were spawned from. When they reach these calm waters, the male uses its beautiful fins in courtship dances, and the horn on its head to bore out nests in the riverbed. Researchers are fiercely divisive on whether the horns or the fins are what attract a female Seaking.
Species_seel_Description: Seel's thick, insulating blubber keeps it warm in the frigid waters of its icy ocean home. When it spots prey underwater, it moves with impressive speed to catch it, shaking the prey violently until it loses consciousness. While a successful hunter, Seel can often run low on air during long pursuits. If the surface of the water is frozen, it uses the horn on its head to pierce a hole large enough to breathe.
Species_shellder_Description: Shellder’s unique underwater movement is a fascinating sight for divers. It propels itself backward by rhythmically opening and closing its shell, using its internal muscles to swim at surprising speeds. Often, it travels long distances in search of the perfect spot on the seabed to dig a cozy burrow and settle in for rest. However, Shellder is easily sidetracked from its original goal, especially if it spots something tasty on the surface of the waves.
Species_slowbro_Description: When a Slowpoke's tail is bitten by a Shellder, it evolves into Slowbro, gaining a spiral shell that forms a lifelong bond with its host. This shell absorbs leftovers from Slowbro’s meals and secretes a rare toxin that, in small doses, acts as a tranquilizer, leaving Slowbro serenely calm and lost in deep thought. Though its stillness may appear foolish, Slowbro is often contemplating the virtues of this fleeting journey we call life, gazing peacefully at the sea on the horizon.
Species_slowpoke_Description: This Pokémon’s slow metabolism makes its tail nearly insensitive, allowing bites or detachment to go unnoticed for hours—or even days. The taste is apparently irresistible, attracting frequent nibbles from wild Pokémon. Slowpoke can use its tail as bait to lure fish, but it often lacks the energy or motivation to follow through, preferring to simply relax. While some see Slowpoke as ‘dull,’ others admire its ability to live carefree.
Species_snorlax_Description: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.
Species_spearow_Description: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.
Species_squirtle_Description: Because of its friendly and obedient nature, Squirtle is a popular partner for trainers beginning their journey. When it is born, the scutes that make up Squirtle’s shell are soft and squishy to the touch, but within mere minutes they harden into a sleek, resilient fortress. These scutes are also used to store oxygen, allowing it to stay underwater for extended periods of time.
Species_starmie_Description: The mysteries surrounding this Pokémon only compound upon evolution. Starmie's "core" glows in several colors, and it seems to communicate with others of its kind by flashing patterns of colors in rapid succession. By using the psychic power stored in this gem, it can spin its body like a windmill and jettison itself through both water and air.
Species_staryu_Description: If you see red lights blinking across the shoreline at night, you've found a group of Staryu. These strange Pokémon possess impressive regenerative abilities, capable of growing back entire limbs if they are torn off in battle. Studies have found that these abilities stem from the glowing core in the center of its body, which it flashes towards the sky during the night. Rumors state that it does this to communicate with the stars, but what for?
Species_tangela_Description: The thick vines that wrap around Tangela's body shake as it walks, giving it the appearance of a walking blue bush. Despite their bulk, the vines are very brittle and break easily, but this allows it to escape should its vines get caught on anything. When it lays down to sleep, it takes on an appearance similar to a sweet berry bush. It becomes very annoyed if it wakes up to find foxes digging through its vines for berries.
Species_tauros_Description: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won't allow people to ride on their backs.
Species_tentacool_Description: Tentacool is not a particularly good swimmer; most of its movement comes from drifting on the waves. Anyone who mistakes it for an easy target is likely to regret it after being stabbed and pumped full of stinging poison. Its hostility makes it difficult to study, leading researchers to rely on analyzing the dried up remains that wash ashore on new moons.
Species_tentacruel_Description: Its large size prevents Tentacruel from using its old strategy of appearing harmless, so it opts for a more aggressive approach. It engulfs its prey with its tentacles, suffocating them with its lethal poison. While it mostly hunts alone, it's not uncommon to see groups of Tentacruel communicating through intermittent glows from the red orbs on their heads. Unfortunately for some divers, witnessing this behavior can lead to the mistaken belief that the specimens are hunting fish, only to discover that they themselves are on the menu.
Species_vaporeon_Description: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.
Species_venomoth_Description: The wings of this nocturnal Pokémon consist of hundreds of thousands of miniscule scales, which fall off like dust every time Venomoth flaps its wings. Lighter-colored scales cause paralysis, and darker-colored scales cause poison. Many clinics intentionally attract Venomoth with bright lights, making its dust easy to collect for the production of antidotes.
Species_venonat_Description: Venonat's body is coated in thin, stiff hairs, which in turn are coated in mild toxins. These toxins only cause slight irritation in humans and other larger creatures, but are deadly to the small insects Venonat preys upon. Its striking resemblance to Butterfree has caused some researchers to attempt to find a connection, but aside from the two both being Bug-type, there seems to be no evidence for this theory.
Species_venusaur_Description: When Ivysaur gathers enough energy in its bud, it evolves into Venusaur, causing its petals to open and reveal a massive, brightly colored flower. In many farming communities, Venusaur is considered almost legendary, with tales of it staging moonlit gatherings of hundreds of Bulbasaur and Ivysaur. During these mystical rituals, it is said that the Pokémon stimulate plant growth and bring about bountiful harvests.
Species_victreebel_Description: By releasing fragrant scents and flicking about its large, vine-like appendage, Victreebel attracts its Bug-type prey, which it swallows whole. What oozes from its mouth is not sweet honey, but a powerful Acid. Common rumor dictates that Victreebel's acid is strong enough to melt even netherite in a single day, although this has yet to be tested.
Species_vileplume_Description: Its petals are among the largest of any Pokémon. According to careful study, the more vibrant a Vileplume's petals are, the more potent their poisonous pollen is. In the wild, Vileplume bounce up and down, flapping their petals to release this toxic pollen and scare off potential predators.
Species_voltorb_Description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
Species_vulpix_Description: Vulpix can often doze off for hours, but they become irate whenever someone interrupts their slumber. When angered, Vulpix will throw tantrums, spewing volleys of harmless wispy fireballs from their mouth and nose.
Species_wartortle_Description: Its tail and ears are covered in thick, luxurious fur that helps it maintain balance while swimming underwater, expertly maneuvering to stalk and capture its prey. While Wartortle has grown more aggressive with evolution, it makes an excellent partner for trainers in polar regions thanks to its warm fur and skill at hunting.
Species_weedle_Description: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.
Species_weepinbell_Description: Weepinbell hooks itself to tree branches, waiting to douse unaware prey in poisonous powder before dissolving them in its acid. It is ill advised to traverse forests with known Weepinbell populations at night, as it is known to stir in its sleep and may fall from the branch it had hooked itself onto the day before. If it awakes to see a threat, it will quickly dice them up with its razor sharp leaves.
Species_weezing_Description: It can't suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.
Species_wigglytuff_Description: It's proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that's perfectly heavenly.
Species_zapdos_Description: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It's said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.
Species_zubat_Description: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.
Species_aipom_Description: The hand-shaped appendage on Aipom's tail is made up of dense muscle fibers, allowing it to perform all kinds of different tasks; jumping from branch to branch, picking berries, delivering attacks, etc. Some Aipom have even been seen giving each other handshakes with their tails. With this versatile tool at its disposal, its real hands are rarely used, and they end up serving more as a temporary replacement just in case its tail needs time to recover from an injury.
Species_ampharos_Description: Ampharos has lost the ability to grow wool, and its potent electricity is now stored throughout its body. This causes the light on its tail to be incredibly bright, and it is oftentimes used as a beacon to guide ships to shore. Thankfully, Ampharos has much more control over its power now, but touching the orb at the end of its tail is still discouraged, as the discharge can easily knock even a grown Copperajah off its feet.
