Species_yanmega_Description: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.
Species_accelgor_Description: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.
Species_alomomola_Description: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.
Species_amoonguss_Description: Amoonguss generally doesn't move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.
Species_archen_Description: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.
Species_archeops_Description: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.
Species_audino_Description: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.
Species_axew_Description: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn't a concern.
Species_basculin_Description: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
Species_beartic_Description: Beartic is a deadly predator found in frozen regions, feared for its size and ferocity. It will eat anything it can catch, though it favors Swinub and Cetoddle for their nutrient-rich fat layers. When Beartic wants to travel, it uses its icy breath to freeze a bridge across the ocean—sometimes stretching beyond the horizon.
Species_beheeyem_Description: The appearance of a Beeheyem, while exceedingly rare, is always accompanied by strange events; missing livestock, short-term memory loss, flickering lights, headaches, electronic malfunctions, and even possible short-term memory loss. Beeheyem is rumored to be capable of speaking to humans telepathically, and those who have spoken with it claim that Beeheeyem comes from beyond the stars in the sky... but how could that be possible?
Species_bisharp_Description: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.
Species_blitzle_Description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
Species_boldore_Description: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.
Species_bouffalant_Description: Bouffalant charges with mighty power and headbutts any threats with enough force to knock over a Ravager. Its fluffy fur absorbs the impact, protecting its skull from harm. Despite its formidable strength, groups of these robust Pokémon are known to live peacefully with other species in their habitat. Some small bird Pokémon even perch in its thick hair for warmth, in return helping by keeping away pests. This balance between tremendous might and compassionate nature earned it the title of "Guardian of the Plains."
Species_braviary_Description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
Species_carracosta_Description: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.
Species_chandelure_Description: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it's said.
Species_cinccino_Description: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.
Species_cobalion_Description: From the moment it's born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.
Species_cofagrigus_Description: The curse that sought to dominate its mind finally took hold after evolution, causing it to lose all memories of its ancient past. Now, it lays in wait in graveyards and tombs to violently capture intruders with its four shadowy arms. Cofagrigus holds its victims within its golden body for days, gradually inflicting them with the same incurable madness that it was once cursed with. Thus, the cycle lives.
Species_conkeldurr_Description: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.
Species_cottonee_Description: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.
Species_crustle_Description: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.
Species_cryogonal_Description: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.
Species_cubchoo_Description: Though many assume Cubchoo is sick at first glance, the large, sticky glob of snot hanging from its nose actually indicates good health. This freezing substance fuels its Ice-type attacks, and touching it can cause frostbite. If Cubchoo stays in warm areas too long, the snot melts away, leaving it unable to defend itself.
Species_darmanitan_Description: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
Species_darumaka_Description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.
Species_deerling_Description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
Species_deino_Description: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.
Species_dewott_Description: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
Species_drilbur_Description: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.
Species_druddigon_Description: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
Species_ducklett_Description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
Species_duosion_Description: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.
Species_durant_Description: Durant work in large colonies, defending their nest from Heatmor, their natural predator. They cover themselves in thick, steel armor to protect themselves, but because this steel has a low melting point, this behavior only makes Heatmor's life easier. Some smarter Durant realize this and break away from the colony to live in solidarity, but examples of this behavior are few and far between.
Species_dwebble_Description: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.
Species_eelektrik_Description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
Species_eelektross_Description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
Species_elgyem_Description: This Pokémon seems to be continuously shrouded in mystery. The first known reports of Elgyem come from a farmer that witnessed an unidentified object crash into their wheat fields. According to their record, the Pokémon that emerged carved a pattern through the wheat, flashed the lights on its hands, and then flew off into the night. However, many believe this event was just an elaborate hoax.
Species_emboar_Description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
Species_emolga_Description: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can't fly properly.
Species_escavalier_Description: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch'd.
Species_excadrill_Description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.
Species_ferroseed_Description: Ferroseed can stick its grassy spikes into cave walls and drill to absorb minerals, with iron being a particular favorite snack among many specimens. This unique method of nutrition allows it to maintain and develop its protective metallic coating. Additionally, it can release and shoot these spikes in all different directions. However, its aim is often imprecise, and it may accidentally hit its own companions in the process.
Species_ferrothorn_Description: The spikes on Ferrothorn's peelers allow it to attach to the ceilings of lush caves, absorbing a substantial amount of minerals in a manner similar to the surrounding vegetation. While the species isn’t particularly territorial, some Ferrothorn will occasionally drop from their high perches, landing right on top of unsuspecting passersby. Its metallic body carries a brutal weight, making survival from such an impact a challenge for most.
Species_foongus_Description: The spores released from this Pokémon's hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.
Species_fraxure_Description: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure's favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.
Species_frillish_Description: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.
Species_galvantula_Description: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.
Species_garbodor_Description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.
Species_genesect_Description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
Species_gigalith_Description: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.
Species_golett_Description: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.
Species_golurk_Description: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.
Species_gothita_Description: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it's speaking to something only it can see.
Species_gothitelle_Description: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.
Species_gothorita_Description: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon's psychic power is at its strongest. It's unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.
Species_gurdurr_Description: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.
Species_haxorus_Description: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.
Species_heatmor_Description: Heatmor's long, fiery tongue allows it to melt straight through the exoskeleton of its prey, Durant, and consume the liquified insides. This is near-effortless on its part, and it tends to grow very lax because of this. Rarely, colonies of Durant can exploit this weakness and defeat a Heatmor that has let its guard down for too long.
Species_herdier_Description: The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.
Species_hydreigon_Description: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.
Species_jellicent_Description: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
Species_joltik_Description: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They're often found sticking to Yamper's hindquarters.
Species_karrablast_Description: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet's shell. Karrablast doesn't eat the shell— it eats only the contents.
Species_keldeo_Description: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon's true power will awaken.
Species_klang_Description: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.
Species_klink_Description: It's suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people's invention of the first gears.
Species_klinklang_Description: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn't a living creature.
Species_krokorok_Description: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won't move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.
Species_krookodile_Description: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.
Species_kyurem_Description: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
Species_lampent_Description: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.
Species_landorus_Description: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
Species_larvesta_Description: A rare and mysterious Pokémon that makes its nest within long-forgotten ruins. Though small, Larvesta is capable of defending itself by spewing fire from its five horns. However, it has trouble controlling these flames, and it can easily start a forest fire by mistake. When the time comes for it to evolve, it is cloaked in a flaming cocoon, shining as bright as the dawn.
Species_leavanny_Description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
Species_liepard_Description: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.
Species_lilligant_Description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
Species_lillipup_Description: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won't forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.
Species_litwick_Description: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.
Species_mandibuzz_Description: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.
Species_maractus_Description: Underneath its hearty skin and thorns, Maractus stores hundreds of nutrient-rich seeds in its body. When it dances, the seeds inside it shake and create an upbeat melody. This noise, paired with its ability to spew out its seeds at high velocity, seems to keep would-be predators at bay.
Species_meloetta_Description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
Species_mienfoo_Description: Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.
Species_mienshao_Description: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.
Species_minccino_Description: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.
Species_munna_Description: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.
Species_musharna_Description: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.
Species_oshawott_Description: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.
Species_palpitoad_Description: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.
Species_panpour_Description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
Species_pansage_Description: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.
Species_pansear_Description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
Species_patrat_Description: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.
Species_pawniard_Description: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.
Species_petilil_Description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
Species_pidove_Description: It's forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.
Species_pignite_Description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
Species_purrloin_Description: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.
Species_reshiram_Description: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.
Species_reuniclus_Description: It's said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.
Species_roggenrola_Description: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.
Species_rufflet_Description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
Species_samurott_Description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
Species_sandile_Description: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it's swimming.
Species_sawk_Description: The karate chops of a Sawk that's trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.
Species_sawsbuck_Description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
Species_scolipede_Description: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.
Species_scrafty_Description: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
Species_scraggy_Description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.
Species_seismitoad_Description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.
Species_serperior_Description: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
Species_servine_Description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
Species_sewaddle_Description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
Species_shelmet_Description: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.
Species_sigilyph_Description: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.
Species_simipour_Description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
Species_simisage_Description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
Species_simisear_Description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
Species_snivy_Description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.
Species_solosis_Description: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon's body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.
Species_stoutland_Description: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It's said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.
Species_stunfisk_Description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.
Species_swadloon_Description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
Species_swanna_Description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
Species_swoobat_Description: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.
Species_tepig_Description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
Species_terrakion_Description: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.
Species_throh_Description: They train in groups of five. Any member that can't keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.
Species_thundurus_Description: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
Species_timburr_Description: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.
Species_tirtouga_Description: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.
Species_tornadus_Description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.
Species_tranquill_Description: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.
Species_trubbish_Description: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.
Species_tympole_Description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.
Species_tynamo_Description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
Species_unfezant_Description: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.
Species_vanillish_Description: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.
Species_vanillite_Description: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.
Species_vanilluxe_Description: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.
Species_venipede_Description: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.
Species_victini_Description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.
Species_virizion_Description: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.
Species_volcarona_Description: Ancient carvings suggest that Volcarona was once worshiped as an embodiment of the sun and a savior on darkened days, with massive temples being constructed in its honor. Sometimes, it can still be found within these crumbled halls, driving out unwanted visitors in a fiery rage. When the time comes to find a mate, it performs elaborate courtship rituals high above the clouds, dancing across the sky and scattering embers in the breeze.
Species_vullaby_Description: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.
Species_watchog_Description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
Species_whimsicott_Description: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.
Species_whirlipede_Description: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it'll need for evolution.
Species_woobat_Description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.
Species_yamask_Description: A cursed spirit that aimlessly roams the ruins of ancient civilizations. The mask it carries serves as a link to its former self, holding all the memories of its past life. While a Yamask can lead a relatively calm and content unlife, they all universally fear losing their mask or having it stolen, worried that their minds might be overtaken by darkness and their memories erased.
Species_zebstrika_Description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
Species_zekrom_Description: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom's lightning.
Species_zoroark_Description: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
Species_zorua_Description: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
Species_zweilous_Description: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.
Species_aegislash_Description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
Species_amaura_Description: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.
Species_aromatisse_Description: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent's will to fight.
Species_aurorus_Description: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.
Species_avalugg_Description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
Species_barbaracle_Description: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy's defeat.
Species_bergmite_Description: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
Species_binacle_Description: If the two don't work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won't survive.
Species_braixen_Description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
Species_bunnelby_Description: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.
Species_carbink_Description: Carbink are found deep underground, where they were born from high temperatures and pressure millenia ago. It tends to be found more frequently near ore deposits in particular, so seeing one is often considered a good omen among mining settlements. However, the jewels comprising its body become brittle if removed, so they are not well-suited for forging tools and armor. Carbink mainly uses these jewels to fire beams of energy that punish would-be attackers.
Species_chesnaught_Description: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
Species_chespin_Description: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.
Species_clauncher_Description: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.
Species_clawitzer_Description: Clawitzer's right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer's cannon arm can sink a tanker.
Species_dedenne_Description: Since Dedenne can't generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.
Species_delphox_Description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.
Species_diancie_Description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
Species_diggersby_Description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.
Species_doublade_Description: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.
Species_dragalge_Description: Despite its enhanced abilities after evolution, Dragalge prefers to maintain its strategy of camouflaging itself as dead seaweed rather than adopting a more aggressive approach. However, it occasionally uses its poison to corrode the undersides of boats, consuming or discarding their contents. This behavior is thought to be driven by several possible reasons: a territorial response to invaders, an attempt to steal fish, or perhaps a hint of sadistic tendencies acquired from its new draconic essence.
Species_espurr_Description: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.
Species_fennekin_Description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.
Species_flabebe_Description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
Species_fletchinder_Description: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.
Species_fletchling_Description: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.
Species_floette_Description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
Species_florges_Description: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
Species_froakie_Description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
Species_frogadier_Description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.
Species_furfrou_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_gogoat_Description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
Species_goodra_Description: Few trainers have the patience to raise Goomy long enough for it to evolve into this Pokémon, but those that do find Goodra to be a Pokémon of formidable strength. The acidic mucus that coats its skin is much less potent than that of Sliggoo, but it makes up for this with its deceptively muscular horns and tail. Despite its strength, it has a meek disposition and prefers to surround itself with friends. If you find yourself being one of these friends, don't get mad when Goodra gives you an extra-slimey hug.
Species_goomy_Description: Many consider Goomy to be the weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, but its slimy body is durable and most attacks simply slide off it. The film that covers its skin dries out in the sun, which is why it prefers dark, damp places. However, it gathers the majority of its nutrients from rainwater, so it will often choose to stay near the surface.
Species_gourgeist_Description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
Species_greninja_Description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
Species_hawlucha_Description: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.
Species_heliolisk_Description: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.
Species_helioptile_Description: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.
Species_honedge_Description: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.
Species_hoopa_Description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.
Species_inkay_Description: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.
Species_klefki_Description: This mysterious Pokémon has a strange fondness for keys, and it is perfectly willing to snatch up any that happen to be left unguarded. This tendency has given it a reputation as a pest in many places, although some entrust it with valuable passkeys as protection from thieves. Klefki is especially fond of rare and unusual keys, and is thus often found within the mazelike tunnels of Trial Chambers.
Species_litleo_Description: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.
Species_malamar_Description: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.
Species_meowstic_Description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.
Species_noibat_Description: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat's ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.
Species_noivern_Description: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.
Species_pancham_Description: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.
Species_pangoro_Description: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
Species_phantump_Description: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.
Species_pumpkaboo_Description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
Species_pyroar_Description: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.
Species_quilladin_Description: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.
Species_scatterbug_Description: Scatterbug's small size and limited mobility make it a frequent target for predators. To defend itself, it disperses scales coated with a paralyzing toxin, which it accumulates from consuming poisonous plants like lily of the valley and various mushrooms. These scales also form an insulating cloak around its body, allowing it to survive in extremely harsh conditions.
Species_skiddo_Description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
Species_skrelp_Description: Skrelp camouflages itself among vegetation, resembling dead seaweed. This cunning Pokémon often forms a cooperative bond with Dhelmise, as both are adept at blending in as mere sea elements. Skrelp waits for larger predators to approach, then sprays its poison to stun them before Dhelmise finishes the job. In return, Dhelmise shields Skrelp from other threats and provides support against strong tides.
Species_sliggoo_Description: Sliggoo relies primarily on its horns to sense food, and when it does, it uses a strong acid it produces to dissolve and digest anything it comes across. Upon evolution, its organs all shifted into the lump on its back, meaning its eyes have atrophied into weak sensory organs. Because of this, it sometimes accidentally targets its own trainer.
Species_slurpuff_Description: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.
Species_spewpa_Description: During this phase, Spewpa remains largely stationary, focusing on conserving energy for its upcoming evolution. When threatened, it bristles the fur cloak around its body, dispersing toxic scales in all directions. Its body is as tough as rock, so even predators that manage to bypass its spiny defenses will struggle to make a meal out of Spewpa. Consequently, most predators tend to leave it alone.
Species_spritzee_Description: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.
Species_swirlix_Description: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.
Species_sylveon_Description: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
Species_talonflame_Description: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.
Species_trevenant_Description: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.
Species_tyrantrum_Description: A single bite of Tyrantrum's massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.
Species_tyrunt_Description: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.
Species_vivillon_Description: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments, using a fine coating of scales to shield themselves from the elements. Vivillon's wing patterns vary depending on their evolution location, providing them with highly specialized camouflage. This particular form evolved from a Spewpa through unknown means, resulting in a unique pattern not found anywhere else
Species_volcanion_Description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
Species_xerneas_Description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
Species_yveltal_Description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
Species_zygarde_Description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
Species_araquanid_Description: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
Species_bewear_Description: You can tell you are in a Bewear’s territory by the toppled trees and pulverized rocks that litter the area. Travelers are advised to avoid regions in which it dwells at all cost, as a single swipe from its powerful arms can send a full-grown Steelix flying. Even when this terrifying Pokémon is tame and friendly, its well-meaning hugs can lead to the serious injury of its trainer.
Species_blacephalon_Description: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.
Species_bounsweet_Description: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.
Species_brionne_Description: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that's leading them.
Species_bruxish_Description: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
Species_buzzwole_Description: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
Species_celesteela_Description: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
Species_charjabug_Description: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.
Species_comfey_Description: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.
Species_cosmoem_Description: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.
Species_cosmog_Description: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.
Species_crabominable_Description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.
Species_crabrawler_Description: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
Species_cutiefly_Description: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.
Species_dartrix_Description: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.
Species_decidueye_Description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
Species_dewpider_Description: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.
Species_dhelmise_Description: This clump of restless green seaweed has found and fused to the anchor of a sunken ship. Dhelmise uses this heavy hunk of steel not only as a body, but as a weapon as well. This oversized bludgeon is employed to target larger prey, like the otherwise unthreatened Wailord. If one strays too close to Dhelmise's shipwreck home, it will tangle and drag it down to the seafloor with its chain-like seaweed before using its anchor to deal the final blow.
Species_drampa_Description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.
Species_fomantis_Description: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.
Species_golisopod_Description: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner's meal.
Species_grubbin_Description: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
Species_gumshoos_Description: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
Species_guzzlord_Description: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
Species_hakamo-o_Description: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.
Species_incineroar_Description: Incineroar's rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.
Species_jangmo-o_Description: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that's become as hard as metal.
Species_kartana_Description: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
Species_komala_Description: This Pokémon spends its entire life in a comatose state due to toxins in the leaves comprising its diet; even newly-hatched Komala are born asleep. Every movement it makes is just it tossing and turning in its dreams, which so conveniently happen to coincide with events in the waking world, such as battles. Researchers have attempted to study these dreams to find out how this is, but Komala seems to have an awareness of when it is being studied, and it lashes out violently.
Species_kommo-o_Description: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
Species_litten_Description: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.
Species_lunala_Description: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.
Species_lurantis_Description: The petals on this Pokémon's arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.
Species_lycanroc_Description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.
Species_magearna_Description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
Species_mareanie_Description: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.
Species_marshadow_Description: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.
Species_mimikyu_Description: This Pokémon tends to reside in dry, dark places, where no moisture can damage the rags it cloaks itself in. Perhaps in an effort to appear less frightful and more loveable, Mimikyu fashions its rags into a Pikachu-like disguise. However, the result comes out to be... rather creepy. Despite this, it would seem that this Pokémon has developed a small number of fans who find its patchwork disguise and attention-seeking nature endearing.
Species_morelull_Description: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.
Species_mudbray_Description: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.
Species_mudsdale_Description: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.
Species_naganadel_Description: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
Species_necrozma_Description: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.
Species_nihilego_Description: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
Species_oranguru_Description: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
Species_oricorio_Description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
Species_palossand_Description: It is said that when a Drowned is reanimated, its departed soul joins a colony of others to create a Palossand.
Species_passimian_Description: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
Species_pheromosa_Description: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
Species_pikipek_Description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
Species_poipole_Description: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
Species_popplio_Description: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.
Species_primarina_Description: For Primarina, every battle's a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.
Species_pyukumuku_Description: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.
Species_ribombee_Description: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.
Species_rockruff_Description: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
Species_rowlet_Description: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.
Species_salandit_Description: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.
Species_salazzle_Description: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.
Species_sandygast_Description: Sandygast are very protective of the shovels embedded in their heads. However, it doesn't seem to be made of any known material.
Species_shiinotic_Description: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don't go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.
Species_silvally_Description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
Species_solgaleo_Description: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.
Species_stakataka_Description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
Species_steenee_Description: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.
Species_stufful_Description: Many people love this Pokémon due to its adorable appearance, and it is especially popular with children. Unfortunately, Stufful hates being touched by anyone except its friends, causing it to lash out violently with enough force to pulverize stone. Despite its strength, it feeds primarily on berries and spends most of its time sleeping.
Species_tapu-bulu_Description: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula'ula controls plants.
Species_tapu-fini_Description: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
Species_tapu-koko_Description: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
Species_tapu-lele_Description: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
Species_togedemaru_Description: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
Species_torracat_Description: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat's fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.
Species_toucannon_Description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
Species_toxapex_Description: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.
Species_trumbeak_Description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
Species_tsareena_Description: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.
Species_turtonator_Description: Turtonator commonly buries itself in basalt deltas, waiting for its prey to wander too close. If stepped on, it will detonate the explosive fluid in its shell by striking it with its tail. The resulting explosion is enough to easily take down anything that steps too close. In order to replenish this compound after use, Turtonator seems to hunt and consume Magma Cubes, turning their precious magma cream into fuel for its explosions.
Species_type:-null_Description: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.
Species_vikavolt_Description: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.
Species_wimpod_Description: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.
Species_wishiwashi_Description: Wishiwashi shine their eyes to signal danger as well as communicate, allowing them to call for others of their kind to form a powerful, coordinated school. However, Wishiwashi that are injured have trouble shining their eyes, and cannot form these schools. This leaves them pitifully weak as a result.
Species_xurkitree_Description: They've been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
Species_yungoos_Description: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.
Species_zeraora_Description: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.
Species_melmetal_Description: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
Species_meltan_Description: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.
Species_alcremie_Description: Depending on the conditions in which it evolved, Alcremie can take on a myriad of different forms, each capable of producing a differently flavoured cream. This form's cream is mild in flavor, which it uses to lend a hand in the production of delicious pastries. Alcremie also uses this cream as a defense mechanism, hurling it at foes to confuse and slow them.
Species_appletun_Description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
Species_applin_Description: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
Species_arctovish_Description: The result of jamming two mismatched fossils into a Resurrection Machine. This woeful blunder is a combination of a plate-jawed fish and a frozen, semi-aquatic creature. While this combination of two at least partially aquatic creatures should theoretically work, its head was somehow inverted in the revival process, making it nearly impossible for it to eat and uncomfortable for it to breathe.
Species_arctozolt_Description: The result of jamming two mismatched fossils into a Resurrection Machine. This woeful mistake is a combination of a small, nimble raptor and a frozen, semi-aquatic creature. It only has flippers for legs, but because it cannot breathe underwater, it's forced to awkwardly waddle alongside frozen seas, just waiting for food to wash ashore.
Species_arrokuda_Description: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.
Species_barraskewda_Description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
Species_blipbug_Description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
Species_boltund_Description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
Species_calyrex_Description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
Species_carkol_Description: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
Species_centiskorch_Description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
Species_chewtle_Description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
Species_cinderace_Description: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
Species_clobbopus_Description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.
Species_coalossal_Description: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
Species_copperajah_Description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
Species_corviknight_Description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.
Species_corvisquire_Description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.
Species_cramorant_Description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
Species_cufant_Description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
Species_cursola_Description: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
Species_dottler_Description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
Species_dracovish_Description: The result of jamming two mismatched fossils into a Resurrection Machine. This unfortunate blunder is a combination of a plate-jawed fish and a large, strong-legged creature. While its powerful legs allow it to run extremely well, it cannot breathe outside of the water. Because of this, it tends to just get out its energy by running along the seafloor.
Species_dracozolt_Description: The result of jamming two mismatched fossils into a Resurrection Machine. This unfortunate mistake is a combination of a small, nimble raptor and a large, strong-legged prehistoric creature. While this combination allows for it to ram foes at high speeds, its large legs require much more food than its small mouth and stomach can handle. As a result of this, it spends 90% of its life just eating.
Species_dragapult_Description: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
Species_drakloak_Description: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
Species_drednaw_Description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
Species_dreepy_Description: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
Species_drizzile_Description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
Species_dubwool_Description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
Species_duraludon_Description: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
Species_eiscue_Description: Eiscue live in coastal, frozen seas, making their nests on glaciers and sliding playfully along the ice. The single hair on their heads radiate an intense cold, freezing the seawater around them into a protective block of ice. Although this helmet is heavy, it is very buoyant, allowing Eiscue to travel long distances by simply floating on the current.
Species_eldegoss_Description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
Species_eternatus_Description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
Species_falinks_Description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
Species_flapple_Description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
Species_frosmoth_Description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
Species_glastrier_Description: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
Species_gossifleur_Description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
Species_grapploct_Description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
Species_greedent_Description: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
Species_grimmsnarl_Description: Even though it appears to have gained great muscle strength, this is yet another sneaky deception by Grimmsnarl - these "muscles" are actually part of its hair, which it can unfurl at will to wrap around its opponents like tentacles. It seems to have great confidence in this masquerade, but it gets very angry if anyone happens to sneak a glance at the meek, true body underneath its mane.
Species_grookey_Description: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
Species_hatenna_Description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.
Species_hatterene_Description: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
Species_hattrem_Description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
Species_impidimp_Description: These mischevious Pokémon live in groups deep inside dark, roofed forests that the undead call home. Impdimp will often follow explorers passing through their forest home, watching and giggling as they're swarmed by monsters from all angles - this is because Impidimp feeds off of negative emotion, so a traveler confounded by zombies, skeletons, and spiders alike is a feast for these diminuitive rascals.
Species_indeedee_Description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
Species_inteleon_Description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
Species_kubfu_Description: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
Species_milcery_Description: Exceedingly elusive and shy by nature, Milcery are rarely seen in the wild. They possess a strange affinity for confectioneries, however, and are sometimes drawn to human settlements by the scent of a freshly baked cake. Popular belief states that these cream-bodied Pokémon bring a delicious flavour to any baked good they visit, so Milcery are a welcome sight in most places.
Species_morgrem_Description: What Morgrem lacks in physical strength, it makes up for with cunning and dirty tactics. This Pokémon never fights fairly, and it prefers to feign surrender in order to stab those who corner it with its long, sharp hair. Despite taking great pride in using intelligence over brute force, Morgrem seems to envy physically strong Pokémon such as Machamp.
Species_morpeko_Description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
Species_mr-rime_Description: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
Species_nickit_Description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
Species_obstagoon_Description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
Species_orbeetle_Description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.
Species_perrserker_Description: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
Species_pincurchin_Description: Pincurchin is a dweller of the ocean floor, slowly moving along in search of seagrass to eat. It is very timid in nature, and even a passing current can startle it, causing it to discharge powerful jolts of electricity from its spines. This defense mechanism is effective against most predators in its aquatic environment, but it leaves Pincurchin vulnerable to those with an immunity to electricity.
Species_polteageist_Description: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
Species_raboot_Description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
Species_regidrago_Description: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
Species_regieleki_Description: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.
Species_rillaboom_Description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
Species_rolycoly_Description: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
Species_rookidee_Description: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
Species_runerigus_Description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
Species_sandaconda_Description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
Species_scorbunny_Description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
Species_silicobra_Description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
Species_sinistea_Description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
Species_sirfetchd_Description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
Species_sizzlipede_Description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
Species_skwovet_Description: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.
Species_snom_Description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
Species_sobble_Description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
Species_spectrier_Description: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
Species_stonjourner_Description: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
Species_thievul_Description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
Species_thwackey_Description: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.
Species_toxel_Description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
Species_toxtricity_Description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
Species_urshifu_Description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
Species_wooloo_Description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
Species_yamper_Description: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
Species_zacian_Description: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.
Species_zamazenta_Description: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
Species_zarude_Description: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
Species_basculegion_Description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
Species_enamorus_Description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
Species_kleavor_Description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
Species_overqwil_Description: Huge schools of Overqwil float in the open ocean, slowly drifting along the current. Sailors have dubbed these Pokémon as "Sea Fiends," because of the many shipwrecks they're responsible for. Those who attempt to flee from the wreckage are targeted with the virulent poison they spew from their spikes.
Species_sneasler_Description: This Pokémon reigns supreme at the tops of frozen peaks, using its lanky limbs to traverse harsh cliffs with remarkable ease. The venom dripping from Sneasler's large claws is potent enough to shut down its prey's nervous system, making it a fearsome foe. Sneasler has developed a solitary disposition, preferring to survive alone rather than in a group. Upon evolution, it bids farewell to its former pack and sets out in search of a territory to call its own.
Species_ursaluna_Description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
Species_wyrdeer_Description: Stantler that embrace a more strenuous lifestyle and seek self-improvement are able to evolve into Wyrdeer. This evolution is marked by its distinctive beard, which not only serves as an effective means of retaining heat but also symbolizes the wisdom gained from past battles. Additionally, Wyrdeer’s powerful horns shed and regrow each year to ensure that its psychic forces remain strong. Together, these features have enabled the species to thrive in the coldest reaches of the world.
Species_annihilape_Description: Its primal rage boiled far beyond its limits, finally allowing Annihilape to realize its dream of breaking free from both its violent passion and limiting mortality. This Pokémon has reached a state of tranquility, and it no longer acts with the anger it once did. Although this doesn't mean that its fury has disappeared entirely. When in the heat of battle, Annihilape can reach deep inside its heart to deliver bone-shattering blows filled with every ounce of boiling hatred that it accumulated in its past life.
Species_arboliva_Description: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
Species_archaludon_Description: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.
Species_arctibax_Description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.
Species_armarouge_Description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
Species_baxcalibur_Description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
Species_bellibolt_Description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
Species_bombirdier_Description: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon's chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.
Species_brambleghast_Description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.
Species_bramblin_Description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
Species_brute-bonnet_Description: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
Species_capsakid_Description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
Species_ceruledge_Description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
Species_cetitan_Description: While traversing the snowy wastes, herds of Cetitan and Cetoddle are at risk of attack from Beartic and other tundra predators. Any Pokémon that menaces the young, however, will be met with a blow from Cetitan’s powerful horns. If it cannot handle a fight on its own, it can call for help using a range of sonorous calls, which echo across mountain peaks and can be heard by other Cetitan a great distance away.
Species_cetoddle_Description: Cetoddle are awkward and adventurous, often approaching passing travelers out of curiosity. They are also playful, and can be seen tumbling down mountainside, slamming into rocks and trees at high speeds. They don’t seem to mind, however, as their body is covered in a thick coat of protective blubber.
Species_charcadet_Description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
Species_chien-pao_Description: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.
Species_chi-yu_Description: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.
Species_clodsire_Description: The purple spots on Clodsire's back are actually holes concealing venom-coated spines. While this Pokémon spends most of its time peacefully laying on the reedbed of swamps, if it is stepped on or otherwise threatened, it will unleash its spines to deliver a devestating jab of poison.
Species_crocalor_Description: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.
Species_cyclizar_Description: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
