Species_dachsbun_Description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
Species_dipplin_Description: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
Species_dolliv_Description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
Species_dondozo_Description: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
Species_dudunsparce_Description: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
Species_espathra_Description: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.
Species_farigiraf_Description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.
Species_fezandipiti_Description: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.
Species_fidough_Description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.
Species_finizen_Description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
Species_flamigo_Description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
Species_flittle_Description: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.
Species_floragato_Description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
Species_flutter-mane_Description: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
Species_frigibax_Description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.
Species_fuecoco_Description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
Species_garganacl_Description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
Species_gholdengo_Description: Upon completing its collection of 1,000 coins, a Gimmighoul will evolve into Gholdengo: a friendly Pokémon with a body comprised almost entirely of golden coins. It is capable of manipulating these coins at will, launching them at excessive speed towards foes and forming surfboards or other objects from them. The sheer amount of gold and rares required to get a Gholdengo is the only thing offsetting the average trainer from commanding its nearly unmatched battle prowess.
Species_gimmighoul_Description: These Gimmighoul hide within chests at the top of crumbling towers that have stood since before written history began. Fiercely protective of the treasures they collect, they invite much speculation. Are they loyal guardians of relics left by long-lost trainers, or are they simply bandits content to sit atop their plunder for millenia?
Species_glimmet_Description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
Species_glimmora_Description: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
Species_gouging-fire_Description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
Species_grafaiai_Description: Grafaiai covers the trees in its forest home with colorful patterns made from its paint-like toxic saliva, which changes color depending on the berries it consumes as part of its diet. Each individual creates a unique pattern that it continues to paint throughout its life, making its mark on the environment and expressing its individuality.
Species_great-tusk_Description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
Species_greavard_Description: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
Species_houndstone_Description: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
Species_hydrapple_Description: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
Species_iron-boulder_Description: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
Species_iron-bundle_Description: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.
Species_iron-crown_Description: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
Species_iron-hands_Description: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.
Species_iron-jugulis_Description: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.
Species_iron-leaves_Description: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
Species_iron-moth_Description: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.
Species_iron-thorns_Description: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.
Species_iron-treads_Description: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.
Species_iron-valiant_Description: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.
Species_kilowattrel_Description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.
Species_kingambit_Description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
Species_klawf_Description: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.
Species_koraidon_Description: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.
Species_lechonk_Description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.
Species_lokix_Description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
Species_mabosstiff_Description: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.
Species_maschiff_Description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.
Species_maushold_Description: Most Maushold consist of a larger pair and a smaller pair, but in rare circumstances there will only be one little one. The scarcity of these Maushold has made them difficult to study, and with no information as to the origins of the little ones, it is also unknown why some Maushold only contain a single one.
Species_meowscarada_Description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining in its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
Species_miraidon_Description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
Species_munkidori_Description: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
Species_nacli_Description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
Species_naclstack_Description: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.
Species_nymble_Description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
Species_ogerpon_Description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.
Species_oinkologne_Description: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.
Species_okidogi_Description: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.
Species_orthworm_Description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
Species_palafin_Description: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
Species_pawmi_Description: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
Species_pawmo_Description: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
Species_pawmot_Description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
Species_pecharunt_Description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
Species_poltchageist_Description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
Species_quaquaval_Description: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
Species_quaxly_Description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
Species_quaxwell_Description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
Species_rabsca_Description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.
Species_raging-bolt_Description: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.
Species_rellor_Description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.
Species_revavroom_Description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.
Species_roaring-moon_Description: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
Species_sandy-shocks_Description: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
Species_scovillain_Description: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
Species_scream-tail_Description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
Species_shroodle_Description: Shroodle is usually quite mellow around those it likes, but it can swiftly turn aggressive, delivering a paralyzing toxic bite to both trainers and Pokémon that get on its bad side. It uses this same poison in its fangs to carve foul-smelling markings around its nest, deterring intruders from approaching.
Species_sinistcha_Description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
Species_skeledirge_Description: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge's head gained a soul.
Species_slither-wing_Description: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
Species_smoliv_Description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
Species_spidops_Description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
Species_sprigatito_Description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
Species_squawkabilly_Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
Species_tadbulb_Description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
Species_tandemaus_Description: These two exhibit unrivaled teamwork and cooperation, sharing their food evenly and coordinating in perfect sync when in battle. Even when searching for materials to make a nest with, Tandemaus never stray away from each other. They're often considered pests by townsfolk, as they'll chew bits of fabric for their nests off of anything they find.
Species_tarountula_Description: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.
Species_tatsugiri_Description: In this form, Tatsugiri seems to be especially appetizing to bottom dwelling Pokémon like Corphish. However, its appearance is a ruse. Whenever a Pokémon approaches it, Dondozo will burst up from under the sand and swallow it whole. After a day's hunt is over, the two Pokémon split the food they have gathered.
Species_terapagos_Description: It's thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.
Species_ting-lu_Description: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
Species_tinkatink_Description: This meek little Pokémon is oftentimes bullied by Pokémon that eat or collect metal. Tinkatink must reconstruct its precious rattle-like hammer over and over again after each time it's been stolen. They often hang out near ruins, as they're not only a good source of ancient scrap metal, but archeologists often forget their tools here, which Tinkatink happily repurpose.
Species_tinkaton_Description: Despite its diminutive stature, Tinkaton swings around its massive hammer with little effort. Estimates show that this massive collage of scrap metal is similar in weight to that of an iron golem, and a direct hit from it is enough to crush deepslate into dust. It uses this hulking weapon to target even the largest of Steel-type Pokémon, which stand no chance against it.
Species_tinkatuff_Description: Finally able to make a hammer worthy of a fight, Tinkatuff sets out on a quest for revenge against those that bullied it as a Tinkatink. It pulverizes Pokémon like Bisharp and Aron, taking scraps of their metal to further enhance its hammer. With every victory, it takes a small trophy. When groups of Tinkatuff gather, they take turns showing off these trophies and their hammers to one another.
Species_toedscool_Description: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
Species_toedscruel_Description: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.
Species_varoom_Description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
Species_veluza_Description: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
Species_walking-wake_Description: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.
Species_wattrel_Description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
Species_wiglett_Description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
Species_wo-chien_Description: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
Species_wugtrio_Description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
Species_aerodactyl-mega_Description: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.
Species_alakazam-mega_Description: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.
Species_arcanine-hisui_Description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
Species_articuno-galar_Description: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.
Species_beedrill-mega_Description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
Species_blastoise-mega_Description: The cannon-like structures on this Pokémon’s shell are composed of specialized bones that can shoot powerful jets of water. These water bolts are capable of punching through solid iron, even from across the sea. While its cannons make Blastoise a force to be reckoned with, it tends to avoid humans, preferring to oversee groups of Squirtle and Wartortle on distant, uninhabited islands.
Species_blastoise-gmax_Description: The cannon-like structures on this Pokémon’s shell are composed of specialized bones that can shoot powerful jets of water. These water bolts are capable of punching through solid iron, even from across the sea. While its cannons make Blastoise a force to be reckoned with, it tends to avoid humans, preferring to oversee groups of Squirtle and Wartortle on distant, uninhabited islands.
Species_butterfree-gmax_Description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
Species_charizard-mega-x_Description: With the experience of countless battles, Charmeleon has evolved into Charizard, a ferocious Pokémon adept at both aerial and grounded combat. Held aloft by its powerful wings, it soars inside the caverns of the Nether, searching for worthy foes. When Charizard grows weary from its many battles, it bathes in a pool of molten lava, a behavior which seems to aid in the process of healing and relaxation.
Species_charizard-mega-y_Description: With the experience of countless battles, Charmeleon has evolved into Charizard, a ferocious Pokémon adept at both aerial and grounded combat. Held aloft by its powerful wings, it soars inside the caverns of the Nether, searching for worthy foes. When Charizard grows weary from its many battles, it bathes in a pool of molten lava, a behavior which seems to aid in the process of healing and relaxation.
Species_charizard-gmax_Description: With the experience of countless battles, Charmeleon has evolved into Charizard, a ferocious Pokémon adept at both aerial and grounded combat. Held aloft by its powerful wings, it soars inside the caverns of the Nether, searching for worthy foes. When Charizard grows weary from its many battles, it bathes in a pool of molten lava, a behavior which seems to aid in the process of healing and relaxation.
Species_cubone-alola_Description: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.
Species_diglett-alola_Description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
Species_dugtrio-alola_Description: These Diglett triplets dig over 6 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
Species_eevee-gmax_Description: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.
Species_electrode-hisui_Description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 2 lightning bolts.
Species_exeggcute-alola_Description: Often mistaken for a clutch of Pokémon Eggs, Exeggcute are more similar in body structure to cocoa beans. There are six "seeds" in total, they communicate and coordinate with each other using telepathy, and can reunite quickly if seperated. They use these same extrasensory powers to ward off predators.
Species_exeggutor-alola_Description: Exeggutor are known to grow at vastly different rates depending on the amount of sunlight they get. This particular breed of Exeggutor has grown to such a monstrous size that ancient recessive genes seemed to awaken upon evolving from Exeggcute, abandoning their reliance on psychic abilities and awakening the heart of a slumbering dragon.
Species_farfetchd-galar_Description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.
Species_gengar-mega_Description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
Species_gengar-gmax_Description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
Species_geodude-alola_Description: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.
Species_golem-alola_Description: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
Species_graveler-alola_Description: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.
Species_grimer-alola_Description: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.
Species_growlithe-hisui_Description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
Species_gyarados-mega_Description: Every Gyarados starts its life as a pitiful Magikarp, fighting for survival in the wild. The sudden transformation from flopping prey to colossal force of destruction causes their brains to go berserk; after evolving, Gyarados crave little more than destruction and ash.
Species_kangaskhan-mega_Description: Powerfully built and covered in thick armored plating, Kangaskhan is a force to be reckoned with, especially when protecting its young. It raises its child in a special pouch, keeping it warm and safe from predators. Although the juvenile must eventually set out into the world to have its own children, the act of a baby Kangaskhan actually leaving its mother's pouch is undocumented.
Species_kingler-gmax_Description: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
Species_koffing-galar_Description: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.
Species_lapras-gmax_Description: Schools of these gentle Pokémon travel to tropical waters to mate and raise their young before returning to the glacial seas where they make their homes. Lapras are highly intelligent, and their calls are believed to be a complex form of communication. Due to their docile nature, they are often used as transportation in coastal settlements.
Species_machamp-gmax_Description: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.
Species_marowak-alola_Description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
Species_meowth-alola_Description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
Species_meowth-galar_Description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
Species_meowth-gmax_Description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
Species_mewtwo-mega-x_Description: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew's. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.
Species_mewtwo-mega-y_Description: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew's. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.
Species_moltres-galar_Description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.
Species_mr-mime-galar_Description: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.
Species_muk-alola_Description: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
Species_ninetales-alola_Description: This calm and delicate form of Ninetales resides on the peaks of frozen mountains, and will often help lost and frostbitten hikers make their way back to safety. However, it doesn't do this out of kindness, it simply wants these people to leave.
Species_persian-alola_Description: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
Species_pidgeot-mega_Description: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.
Species_pikachu-partner_Description: Pikachu’s adorable appearance attracts many admirers, but its unpredictable temper makes it less suited for beginning trainers. When startled or annoyed, Pikachu instinctively discharges electricity from the specialized organs in its cheeks. Even trained Pikachu can react this way, so caution is advised. When large groups of Pikachu gather, the collective electric charge in the air is strong enough to create thunderstorms.
Species_pikachu-gmax_Description: Pikachu’s adorable appearance attracts many admirers, but its unpredictable temper makes it less suited for beginning trainers. When startled or annoyed, Pikachu instinctively discharges electricity from the specialized organs in its cheeks. Even trained Pikachu can react this way, so caution is advised. When large groups of Pikachu gather, the collective electric charge in the air is strong enough to create thunderstorms.
Species_pikachu-alola_Description: Pikachu’s adorable appearance attracts many admirers, but its unpredictable temper makes it less suited for beginning trainers. When startled or annoyed, Pikachu instinctively discharges electricity from the specialized organs in its cheeks. Even trained Pikachu can react this way, so caution is advised. When large groups of Pikachu gather, the collective electric charge in the air is strong enough to create thunderstorms.
Species_pinsir-mega_Description: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.
Species_ponyta-galar_Description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.
Species_raichu-alola_Description: This Raichu form uses its newfound psychic abilities to regulate its electric charge, resulting in a calm and relaxed temperament. The origin of its psychic powers remains a mystery, but it uses them to balance on its tail and levitate. It can often be seen hovering over coastal seas, seeking out the tallest waves to ride using its psychic-enhanced surfing skills.
Species_rapidash-galar_Description: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.
Species_raticate-alola_Description: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
Species_rattata-alola_Description: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 4 more live in the area.
Species_sandshrew-alola_Description: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
Species_sandslash-alola_Description: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
Species_slowbro-mega_Description: When a Slowpoke's tail is bitten by a Shellder, it evolves into Slowbro, gaining a spiral shell that forms a lifelong bond with its host. This shell absorbs leftovers from Slowbro’s meals and secretes a rare toxin that, in small doses, acts as a tranquilizer, leaving Slowbro serenely calm and lost in deep thought. Though its stillness may appear foolish, Slowbro is often contemplating the virtues of this fleeting journey we call life, gazing peacefully at the sea on the horizon.
Species_slowbro-galar_Description: When a Slowpoke's tail is bitten by a Shellder, it evolves into Slowbro, gaining a spiral shell that forms a lifelong bond with its host. This shell absorbs leftovers from Slowbro’s meals and secretes a rare toxin that, in small doses, acts as a tranquilizer, leaving Slowbro serenely calm and lost in deep thought. Though its stillness may appear foolish, Slowbro is often contemplating the virtues of this fleeting journey we call life, gazing peacefully at the sea on the horizon.
Species_slowpoke-galar_Description: This Pokémon’s slow metabolism makes its tail nearly insensitive, allowing bites or detachment to go unnoticed for hours—or even days. The taste is apparently irresistible, attracting frequent nibbles from wild Pokémon. Slowpoke can use its tail as bait to lure fish, but it often lacks the energy or motivation to follow through, preferring to simply relax. While some see Slowpoke as ‘dull,’ others admire its ability to live carefree.
Species_snorlax-gmax_Description: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.
Species_tauros-paldea-combat_Description: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won't allow people to ride on their backs.
Species_tauros-paldea-blaze_Description: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won't allow people to ride on their backs.
Species_tauros-paldea-aqua_Description: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won't allow people to ride on their backs.
Species_venusaur-mega_Description: When Ivysaur gathers enough energy in its bud, it evolves into Venusaur, causing its petals to open and reveal a massive, brightly colored flower. In many farming communities, Venusaur is considered almost legendary, with tales of it staging moonlit gatherings of hundreds of Bulbasaur and Ivysaur. During these mystical rituals, it is said that the Pokémon stimulate plant growth and bring about bountiful harvests.
Species_venusaur-gmax_Description: When Ivysaur gathers enough energy in its bud, it evolves into Venusaur, causing its petals to open and reveal a massive, brightly colored flower. In many farming communities, Venusaur is considered almost legendary, with tales of it staging moonlit gatherings of hundreds of Bulbasaur and Ivysaur. During these mystical rituals, it is said that the Pokémon stimulate plant growth and bring about bountiful harvests.
Species_voltorb-hisui_Description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
Species_vulpix-alola_Description: Sometimes called Keokeo, these highly sociable variants of Vulpix form into groups and make their dens inside powder snow. However, don't tread too close to these packs, as there is always a Ninetales nearby, ready to freeze any threat to the bone.
Species_weezing-galar_Description: It can't suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.
Species_zapdos-galar_Description: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It's said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.
Species_ampharos-mega_Description: Ampharos has lost the ability to grow wool, and its potent electricity is now stored throughout its body. This causes the light on its tail to be incredibly bright, and it is oftentimes used as a beacon to guide ships to shore. Thankfully, Ampharos has much more control over its power now, but touching the orb at the end of its tail is still discouraged, as the discharge can easily knock even a grown Copperajah off its feet.
Species_corsola-galar_Description: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.
Species_cyndaquil-hisui_Description: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.
Species_heracross-mega_Description: Male specimens often dispute with each other over territory or potential mates. These disputes are settled by a direct clash of horns, hands, strength, and technique; the moment one is flipped onto its back, the conflict is decided. Despite this occasional rivalry, Heracross are generally peaceful, and they even use their horns to protect other Bug Pokémon from predators. The ones under their guard often establish a symbiotic relationship with them, repaying their protection by offering Heracross some honey, their favorite treat.
Species_houndoom-mega_Description: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.
Species_pichu-alola_Description: While Pichu are in possession of impressive electrical power, they have yet to learn how to control it and tend to shock themselves as much as their opponents. Interestingly, groups of Pichu have been seen intentionally triggering these discharges by touching tails, creating a shower of sparks in the process. Researchers believe this is an attempt to gain more mastery over their abilities.
Species_quilava-hisui_Description: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.
Species_qwilfish-hisui_Description: Living in colder waters seems to have caused Qwilfish to undergo biological changes. It collects poison from the food it eats and pumps it all into its thick venomous spines for later use. Compared to their tropical relatives, these Pokémon are known to be even more ill-tempered, garnering them an unfavorable reputation among anglers.
Species_scizor-mega_Description: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.
Species_slowking-galar_Description: Slowking receives a stimulant injected directly into its brain by the Shellder clamped onto its head, resulting in a remarkable boost in intellect and intuition. Some Slowbro even gather to follow it as servants, drawn by its cool confidence and strategic wisdom in difficult situations. The only thing that disrupts its composure is losing an intellectual challenge—a rare occurrence, of course.
Species_sneasel-hisui_Description: This form of Sneasel has adapted to perilous cliffs, using its hooked claws to scale the mountainsides. Unlike its devious Dark-type counterpart, it and its pack prefer direct attacks on their prey. Don’t mistake its lack of craftiness for docility, however—the special venom secreted from its claws can damage the nerves of anything they slash.
Species_steelix-mega_Description: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.
Species_typhlosion-hisui_Description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
Species_tyranitar-mega_Description: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.
Species_unown-f_Description: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.
Species_wooper-paldea_Description: This playful Pokémon enjoys splashing around in the muddy waters of its habitat, sociable to not only its own kind but to other Pokémon and humans as well. Unfortunately, it doesn't know that the membrane that keeps its body moist on land contains a weak numbing toxin. If you pat a Wooper on the head, you may be unable to feel your hand for the next few hours.
Species_absol-mega_Description: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.
Species_aggron-mega_Description: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon's strength.
Species_altaria-mega_Description: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it's provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.
Species_banette-mega_Description: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.
Species_blaziken-mega_Description: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 3-story building in one leap. This Pokémon's blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.
Species_camerupt-mega_Description: The pressure within its lava-storing humps is now so great that it is constantly at risk of erupting. However, with careful harvesting, this lava can be extracted and used in metallurgy, making Camerupt a popular Pokémon among blacksmiths. When in need of a refuel, it eats rocks and ore, melting them down using its own body heat.
Species_castform-sunny_Description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!
Species_castform-rainy_Description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!
Species_castform-snowy_Description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!
Species_deoxys-attack_Description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
Species_deoxys-defense_Description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
Species_deoxys-speed_Description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
Species_gardevoir-mega_Description: Gardevoir is fiercely loyal and dedicated to protecting its Trainer, having been in sync with their emotions for so long. Should one it cares about fall in battle, Gardevoir's emotions become too much for it to bear. In a fit of rage and grief, it can expend all of its psychic energy to tear a pitch-dark hole through the dimensions. No creature - human, Pokémon, or otherwise - on the receiving end of this devastating attack has ever been found afterwards.
Species_glalie-mega_Description: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.
Species_groudon-primal_Description: Through Primal Reversion and with nature's full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.
Species_kyogre-primal_Description: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
Species_latias-mega_Description: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.
Species_latios-mega_Description: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
Species_linoone-galar_Description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.
Species_manectric-mega_Description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
Species_mawile-mega_Description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
Species_medicham-mega_Description: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.
Species_metagross-mega_Description: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.
Species_rayquaza-mega_Description: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.
Species_sableye-mega_Description: Sableye can often be found in underground geodes to satiate their unusual diet of minerals, this strange eating habit results in their own bodies being partially comprised of gemstones, with their apparent preference for amethyst in particular contributing to their purple color. Sableye will often fight each other for dibs on the largest clusters in a geode, however, even the most territorial of Sableye will abandon everything if they spot their favorite prey - Carbink.
Species_salamence-mega_Description: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.
Species_sceptile-mega_Description: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.
Species_sharpedo-mega_Description: Sharpedo's specialized skin helps it swim at outstanding speeds, allowing it to perform almost instantaneous onslaughts. This brutal aquatic predator is known as the "Bully of the Sea," a nickname it earned with its insatiable appetite for brutality. Oftentimes, it will attack stone or metal simply because it craves violence, causing its teeth to chip and shatter. Although, its teeth grow back rapidly, allowing it to continue non-stop on its lifelong rampage. Any life in the sea could be its next target; fish, other Pokémon, Drowned, and even living humans.
Species_swampert-mega_Description: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.
Species_zigzagoon-galar_Description: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you've lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.
Species_abomasnow-mega_Description: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.
Species_arceus-fighting_Description: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
Species_arceus-flying_Description: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

Species_arceus-dark_Description: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
Species_arceus-fairy_Description: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
Species_burmy-sandy_Description: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
Species_burmy-trash_Description: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
Species_cherrim-sunshine_Description: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.
Species_dialga-origin_Description: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.
Species_gallade-mega_Description: Upon its evolution, Gallade has quite literally sharpened its psychokinetic energy into blades. It is a master of swordsmanship and chivalry, using its telepathic capabilities to sense those that need its protection. If the situation calls for it, Gallade will fight with cunning and savage tactics. Just by closing its eyes, it can effortlessly glance into the future to predict its opponents' moves, and counter with a blindingly fast strike from the blades on its elbows.
Species_garchomp-mega_Description: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.
Species_gastrodon-east_Description: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.
Species_giratina-origin_Description: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.
Species_lopunny-mega_Description: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.
Species_lucario-mega_Description: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.
Species_mime-jr-galar_Description: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.
Species_palkia-origin_Description: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.
Species_rotom-heat_Description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
Species_rotom-wash_Description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
Species_rotom-frost_Description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
Species_rotom-fan_Description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
Species_rotom-mow_Description: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
Species_shaymin-sky_Description: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.
Species_shellos-east_Description: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!
Species_wormadam-sandy_Description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
Species_wormadam-trash_Description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
Species_audino-mega_Description: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.
Species_braviary-hisui_Description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
Species_darmanitan-zen_Description: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,5 degrees Fahrenheit.
Species_darmanitan-galar_Description: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,5 degrees Fahrenheit.
Species_darmanitan-galar-zen_Description: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,5 degrees Fahrenheit.
Species_darumaka-galar_Description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.
Species_deerling-summer_Description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
Species_deerling-autumn_Description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
Species_deerling-winter_Description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
Species_dewott-hisui_Description: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
Species_garbodor-gmax_Description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.
Species_genesect-water_Description: This Pokémon existed 3 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
Species_genesect-electric_Description: This Pokémon existed 3 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
Species_genesect-fire_Description: This Pokémon existed 3 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
Species_genesect-ice_Description: This Pokémon existed 3 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
Species_keldeo-resolute_Description: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon's true power will awaken.
Species_kyurem-white_Description: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
Species_kyurem-black_Description: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
Species_landorus-therian_Description: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
Species_lilligant-hisui_Description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
Species_meloetta-pirouette_Description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
Species_oshawott-hisui_Description: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.
Species_petilil-hisui_Description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
Species_rufflet-hisui_Description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
Species_samurott-hisui_Description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
Species_sawsbuck-summer_Description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
Species_sawsbuck-autumn_Description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
Species_sawsbuck-winter_Description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
Species_stunfisk-galar_Description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.
Species_thundurus-therian_Description: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
Species_tornadus-therian_Description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.
Species_yamask-galar_Description: A cursed spirit that aimlessly roams the ruins of ancient civilizations. The mask it carries serves as a link to its former self, holding all the memories of its past life. While a Yamask can lead a relatively calm and content unlife, they all universally fear losing their mask or having it stolen, worried that their minds might be overtaken by darkness and their memories erased.
Species_zoroark-hisui_Description: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
Species_zorua-hisui_Description: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
Species_aegislash-blade_Description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
Species_avalugg-hisui_Description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
Species_bergmite-hisui_Description: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
Species_diancie-mega_Description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
Species_flabebe-yellow_Description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
Species_flabebe-orange_Description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
Species_flabebe-blue_Description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
Species_flabebe-white_Description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
Species_floette-yellow_Description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
Species_floette-orange_Description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
Species_floette-blue_Description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
Species_floette-white_Description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
Species_floette-eternal_Description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
Species_florges-yellow_Description: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
Species_florges-orange_Description: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
Species_florges-blue_Description: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
Species_florges-white_Description: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
Species_furfrou-heart_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_furfrou-star_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_furfrou-diamond_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_furfrou-debutante_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_furfrou-matron_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_furfrou-dandy_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_furfrou-kabuki_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_furfrou-pharaoh_Description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
Species_goodra-hisui_Description: It has grown stronger with evolution, but the weight of its shell still causes it to tire more easily. However, if threatened, Goodra can retreat into this shell, a nigh impenetrable stronghold made of iron and other strong minerals. Exceedingly anxious, this Pokémon will go on a violent rampage if its trainer leaves its sight, believing it has been abandoned.
Species_goomy-hisui_Description: Many consider Goomy to be the weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, but its slimy body is durable and most attacks simply slide off it. The film that covers its skin dries out in the sun, which is why it prefers dark, damp places. However, it gathers the majority of its nutrients from rainwater, so it will often choose to stay near the surface.
Species_gourgeist-small_Description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
Species_gourgeist-large_Description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
Species_gourgeist-super_Description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
Species_greninja-bond_Description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
Species_greninja-ash_Description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
Species_hoopa-unbound_Description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.
Species_meowstic-f_Description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.
Species_pumpkaboo-small_Description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
Species_pumpkaboo-large_Description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
Species_pumpkaboo-super_Description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
Species_sliggoo-hisui_Description: The metal that Sliggoo absorbed has solidified into a protective shell. Its temperament has also changed, and it is now less cheerful and more prone to melancholy. Due to the metal that covers the lower half of its body, this Pokémon has a hard time moving, forcing it to use its small arms to pull itself along the ground.
Species_vivillon-pokeball_Description: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments, using a fine coating of scales to shield themselves from the elements. Vivillon's wing patterns vary depending on their evolution location, providing them with highly specialized camouflage. This particular form evolved from a Spewpa through means only apparent to top Vivillonists, resulting in a unique pattern not found anywhere else
Species_xerneas-active_Description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
Species_zygarde-10%_Description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
Species_zygarde-complete_Description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
Species_dartrix-hisui_Description: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.
Species_decidueye-hisui_Description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
Species_lycanroc-midnight_Description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.
Species_lycanroc-dusk_Description: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.
Species_magearna-original_Description: Built roughly 5 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
Species_mimikyu-busted_Description: The force of a blow from battle causes the neck of Mimikyu's disguise to snap. In some unfortunate scenarios, this can also cause the cloth to rip, giving anyone in the area a glimpse at the unknowable mass of shadow underneath. This Pokémon's true form is still unknown, as every scholar who has ventured to research it has either died directly by Mimikyu's hand or lived in mental anguish until their premature demise.
Species_rockruff-dusk_Description: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
Species_rowlet-hisui_Description: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.
Species_silvally-fighting_Description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
Species_silvally-flying_Description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
Species_silvally-poison_Description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

Species_wishiwashi-school_Description: When huge swaths of otherwise weak Wishiwashi come together, they form a gigantic school often referred to as the "demon of the sea" by those who live on the coast. These Pokémon work in terrifying unison to bring down even the toughest foes, with the power of every individual Wishiwashi combined being enough to make even Gyarados flee. This fearsome strength has caused the Pokémon to be mistaken for a legendary beast on multiple occasions.
Species_melmetal-gmax_Description: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
Species_alcremie-gmax_Description: Depending on the conditions in which it evolved, Alcremie can take on a myriad of different forms, each capable of producing a differently flavoured cream. This form's cream is mild in flavor, which it uses to lend a hand in the production of delicious pastries. Alcremie also uses this cream as a defense mechanism, hurling it at foes to confuse and slow them.
Species_appletun-gmax_Description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
Species_calyrex-ice_Description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
Species_calyrex-shadow_Description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
Species_centiskorch-gmax_Description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
Species_cinderace-gmax_Description: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
Species_coalossal-gmax_Description: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
Species_copperajah-gmax_Description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
Species_corviknight-gmax_Description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.
Species_cramorant-gulping_Description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
Species_cramorant-gorging_Description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
Species_drednaw-gmax_Description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
Species_duraludon-gmax_Description: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
Species_eiscue-noice-face_Description: When subject to a particularly forceful blow, the ice blocks that cover an Eiscue's head shatters completely, leaving their small heads exposed. Although they usually tend to avoid this shattering, there are cases where they are seen causing it intentionally. Because they are much quicker without their block, they oftentimes shatter it before diving for their prey.
Species_eternatus-eternamax_Description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 2, years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
Species_flapple-gmax_Description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
Species_grimmsnarl-gmax_Description: Even though it appears to have gained great muscle strength, this is yet another sneaky deception by Grimmsnarl - these "muscles" are actually part of its hair, which it can unfurl at will to wrap around its opponents like tentacles. It seems to have great confidence in this masquerade, but it gets very angry if anyone happens to sneak a glance at the meek, true body underneath its mane.
Species_hatterene-gmax_Description: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
Species_indeedee-f_Description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
Species_inteleon-gmax_Description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
Species_morpeko-hangry_Description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
Species_orbeetle-gmax_Description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.
Species_polteageist-antique_Description: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
Species_rillaboom-gmax_Description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
Species_sandaconda-gmax_Description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
Species_sinistea-antique_Description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
Species_toxtricity-low-key_Description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
Species_toxtricity-gmax_Description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
Species_toxtricity-low-key-gmax_Descript: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
Species_urshifu-gmax_Description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
Species_zacian-crowned_Description: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.
Species_zamazenta-crowned_Description: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
Species_basculegion-f_Description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
Species_enamorus-therian_Description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
Species_dudunsparce-three-segment_Descri: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
Species_gimmighoul-roaming_Description: These Gimmighoul hide within chests at the top of crumbling towers that have stood since before written history began. Fiercely protective of the treasures they collect, they invite much speculation. Are they loyal guardians of relics left by long-lost trainers, or are they simply bandits content to sit atop their plunder for millenia?
Species_maushold-four_Description: The larger pair fiercely defend the smaller pair, biting anything that threatens them with sharp incisors. If that doesn't stop their opponent, the smaller pair will join the fight. However, Maushold prefer living peacefully in their huge nests, which are separated into several rooms that serve different purposes. This curious behavior has led many to theorize that the group is a family, but studies into this behavior have been inconclusive due to the larger pair attacking researchers that get too close to the smaller pair.
Species_oinkologne-f_Description: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.
Species_squawkabilly-blue_Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
Species_squawkabilly-yellow_Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
Species_squawkabilly-white_Description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
