Move_gravity_Effect:
For five turns (including this one), all immunities to ground moves are disabled.  For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages.  Cancels the effects of bounce, fly, and sky drop.
Specifically, flying Pokémon and those with levitate or that have used magnet rise are no longer immune to ground attacks, arena trap, spikes, or toxic spikes.
bounce, fly, sky drop, high jump kick, jump kick, and splash cannot be used while this move is in effect.
*Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of sky drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely.  As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

Move_naturalgift_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry.  The berry is consumed.  If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.
Move_feint_Flavor: This attack hits a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.
Move_feint_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the effects of detect or protect from the target before hitting.

Move_pluck_Flavor: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
Move_pluck_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.
If the target is holding a jaboca berry or rowap berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.
If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.
Move_tailwind_Flavor: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed stats of the user and its allies for four turns.
Move_tailwind_Effect: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled.  This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

If the target has a substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target.

Move_uturn_Effect:

If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first.  If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.
The user may be hit by pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and pursuit has not yet been used.
This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of ingrain.  ingrain’s effect will end.

safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

Move_payback_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.
Move_assurance_Flavor: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.
Move_assurance_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.

Target cannot use its held item for five turns.  If the target leaves the field, this effect ends.
If a Pokémon under this effect uses bug bite or pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used.  If a Pokémon under this effect uses fling, it will fail.
This effect is passed by baton pass.
Move_fling_Flavor: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.
Move_fling_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user’s held item.  The item is consumed.  If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail.
This move ignores sticky hold.
If the user is under the effect of embargo, this move will fail.
Move_psychoshift_Flavor: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.

Move_trumpcard_Flavor: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its power.

PP remaining | Power
------------ | ----:
4 or more    |    40
3            |    50
2            |    60
1            |    80
0            |   200
If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.

Move_doubleedge_Flavor: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.
Move_doubleedge_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
Move_gastroacid_Flavor: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.
Move_gastroacid_Effect:
The target’s ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field.
This effect is passed on by baton pass.
Move_luckychant_Flavor: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits for five turns.
Move_luckychant_Effect: For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits.
Move_mefirst_Flavor: The user cuts ahead of the target to copy and use the target's intended move with greater power. This move fails if it isn't used first.
Move_mefirst_Effect:
If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power.
If the target moves before the user, this move will fail.
This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist, metronome, or sleep talk.
Move_copycat_Flavor: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
Move_copycat_Effect:
Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user.
This move cannot copy itself, nor roar nor whirlwind.
This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist, metronome, or sleep talk.
Move_powerswap_Flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
Move_powerswap_Effect: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.
Move_guardswap_Flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
Move_guardswap_Effect: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.
Move_punishment_Flavor: The more the target has powered up with stat changes, the greater the move's power.
Move_punishment_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200.  Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power.
Move_lastresort_Flavor: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
Move_lastresort_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field.  If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail.
Move_worryseed_Flavor: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.
Move_worryseed_Effect:
Changes the target’s ability to insomnia.
If the target’s ability is truant or multitype, this move will fail.
Move_suckerpunch_Flavor: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
Move_suckerpunch_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.
This move is not affected by iron fist.
Move_tailwhip_Flavor: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stats.
Move_tailwhip_Effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
Move_toxicspikes_Flavor: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
Move_toxicspikes_Effect:
Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field.  A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead.  Pokémon immune to either ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect.  Pokémon otherwise immune to ground moves are affected during gravity.
If a poison Pokémon not immune to ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed.
rapid spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field.  defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field.
This move does not trigger synchronize, unless the Pokémon with synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as roar.
Pokémon entering the field due to baton pass are not affected by this effect.
Move_heartswap_Flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
Move_heartswap_Effect: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.
Move_aquaring_Flavor: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
Move_aquaring_Effect:
Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.
This effect is passed on by baton pass.
Move_magnetrise_Flavor: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
Move_magnetrise_Effect:
For five turns, the user is immune to ground moves.
If the user is under the effect of ingrain or has levitate, this move will fail.
This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during gravity.
This effect is passed on by baton pass.
Move_flareblitz_Flavor: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.
Move_flareblitz_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.  Has a 10% chance to burn the target.  Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.
Move_forcepalm_Flavor: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
Move_forcepalm_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
Move_aurasphere_Flavor: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
Move_aurasphere_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
Move_rockpolish_Flavor: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply raises the Speed stat.
Move_rockpolish_Effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
Move_poisonjab_Flavor: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
Move_poisonjab_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
Move_darkpulse_Flavor: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.
Move_darkpulse_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_cometpunch_Flavor: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.
Move_cometpunch_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Hits 2–5 times in one turn.
Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.
Move_poisonsting_Flavor: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.
Move_poisonsting_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
Move_nightslash_Flavor: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.
Move_nightslash_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
Move_aquatail_Flavor: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
Move_seedbomb_Flavor: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.
Move_airslash_Flavor: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
Move_airslash_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_xscissor_Flavor: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.
Move_bugbuzz_Flavor: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Move_bugbuzz_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Move_dragonpulse_Flavor: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
Move_dragonrush_Flavor: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.
Move_dragonrush_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_powergem_Flavor: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
Move_drainpunch_Flavor: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
Move_drainpunch_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Move_twineedle_Flavor: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. This may also poison the target.
Move_twineedle_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in the same turn.  Has a 20% chance to poison the target.
Move_vacuumwave_Flavor: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.
Move_focusblast_Flavor: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Move_focusblast_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Move_energyball_Flavor: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Move_energyball_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Move_bravebird_Flavor: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
Move_bravebird_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
Move_earthpower_Flavor: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Move_earthpower_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Move_switcheroo_Flavor: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
Move_switcheroo_Effect:
User and target permanently swap held items.  Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything.  If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.
If either Pokémon has multitype or sticky hold, this move will fail.
If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining choice band, choice scarf, or choice specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move.  This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used.  If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.
Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with recycle.
This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.
Move_gigaimpact_Flavor: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.
Move_gigaimpact_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.
Move_nastyplot_Flavor: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_nastyplot_Effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
Move_bulletpunch_Flavor: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.
Move_avalanche_Flavor: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.
Move_avalanche_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power.
pain split does not count as damaging the user.
Move_pinmissile_Flavor: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
Move_pinmissile_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Hits 2–5 times in one turn.
Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.
Move_iceshard_Flavor: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.
Move_shadowclaw_Flavor: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.
Move_shadowclaw_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
Move_thunderfang_Flavor: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
Move_thunderfang_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a separate 10% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_icefang_Flavor: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
Move_icefang_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to freeze the target and a separate 10% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_firefang_Flavor: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.
Move_firefang_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a separate 10% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_shadowsneak_Flavor: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.
Move_mudbomb_Flavor: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. This may also lower the target's accuracy.
Move_mudbomb_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
Move_psychocut_Flavor: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.
Move_psychocut_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
Move_zenheadbutt_Flavor: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
Move_zenheadbutt_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_mirrorshot_Flavor: The user lets loose a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. This may also lower the target's accuracy.
Move_mirrorshot_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
Move_leer_Flavor: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers the Defense stat.
Move_leer_Effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
Move_flashcannon_Flavor: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Move_flashcannon_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Move_rockclimb_Flavor: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. This may also confuse the target.
Move_rockclimb_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.
Move_defog_Flavor: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
Move_defog_Effect:
Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.  Clears away fog.  Removes the effects of mist, light screen, reflect, safeguard, spikes, stealth rock, and toxic spikes from the target’s side of the field.
If the target is protected by mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move.
Move_trickroom_Flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
Move_trickroom_Effect:
For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.  Move priority is not affected.  Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect.
Pokémon holding full incense, lagging tail, or quick claw and Pokémon with stall ignore this effect.
Move_dracometeor_Flavor: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_dracometeor_Effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
Move_discharge_Flavor: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also cause paralysis.
Move_discharge_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
Move_lavaplume_Flavor: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
Move_lavaplume_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to burn the target.
Move_leafstorm_Flavor: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_leafstorm_Effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
Move_powerwhip_Flavor: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.
Move_rockwrecker_Flavor: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can't move on the next turn.
Move_rockwrecker_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.
Move_bite_Flavor: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
Move_bite_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_crosspoison_Flavor: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.
Move_crosspoison_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a 10% chance to poison the target.
Move_gunkshot_Flavor: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.
Move_gunkshot_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
Move_ironhead_Flavor: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.
Move_ironhead_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_magnetbomb_Flavor: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack never misses.
Move_magnetbomb_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
Move_stoneedge_Flavor: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.
Move_stoneedge_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
Move_captivate_Flavor: If any opposing Pokémon is the opposite gender of the user, it is charmed, which harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.
Move_captivate_Effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.  If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail.
Move_stealthrock_Flavor: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
Move_stealthrock_Effect:
Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP.  This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to rock moves.
rapid spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.
Move_grassknot_Flavor: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
Move_grassknot_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.
Target’s weight | Power
--------------- | ----:
Up to 10kg      |    20
Up to 25kg      |    40
Up to 50kg      |    60
Up to 100kg     |    80
Up to 200kg     |   100
Above 200kg     |   120
Move_chatter_Flavor: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.
Move_chatter_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion.  If the user is not a chatot, this move will not cause confusion.
This move cannot be copied by mimic, mirror move, or sketch, nor selected by assist, metronome, or sleep talk.
Move_judgment_Flavor: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move's type varies depending on the kind of Plate the user is holding.
Move_judgment_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.
Note: This effect is technically shared by both techno blast and judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.
Move_growl_Flavor: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.
Move_growl_Effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
Move_bugbite_Flavor: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
Move_bugbite_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.
If the target is holding a jaboca berry or rowap berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.
If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.
Move_chargebeam_Flavor: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.
Move_chargebeam_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 70% chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
Move_woodhammer_Flavor: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.
Move_woodhammer_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
Move_aquajet_Flavor: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This move always goes first.
Move_attackorder_Flavor: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.
Move_attackorder_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
Move_defendorder_Flavor: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
Move_defendorder_Effect: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
Move_healorder_Flavor: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
Move_healorder_Effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.
Move_headsmash_Flavor: The user attacks the target with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.
Move_headsmash_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
Move_doublehit_Flavor: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or a tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.
Move_doublehit_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in one turn.
Move_roaroftime_Flavor: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can't move on the next turn.
Move_roaroftime_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.
Move_roar_Flavor: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
Move_roar_Effect:
Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random.  Wild battles end immediately.
Doesn’t affect Pokémon with suction cups or under the effect of ingrain.
Move_spacialrend_Flavor: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.
Move_spacialrend_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
Move_lunardance_Flavor: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.
Move_lunardance_Effect: User faints.  Its replacement’s HP and PP are fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.
Move_crushgrip_Flavor: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater this move's power.
Move_crushgrip_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.
Move_magmastorm_Flavor: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.
Move_magmastorm_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.
Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.
rapid spin cancels this effect.
Move_darkvoid_Flavor: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.
Move_seedflare_Flavor: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This may also harshly lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Move_seedflare_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 40% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
Move_ominouswind_Flavor: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. This may also raise all the user's stats at once.
Move_ominouswind_Effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a 10% chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.
Move_shadowforce_Flavor: The user disappears, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
Move_shadowforce_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.
This move ignores the effects of detect and protect.
This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.
Move_honeclaws_Flavor: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
Move_honeclaws_Effect: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.
Move_wideguard_Flavor: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
Move_wideguard_Effect:
Moves with multiple targets will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn.  If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.
This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.
Move_sing_Flavor: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.
Move_guardsplit_Flavor: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.
Move_guardsplit_Effect: Averages the user’s unmodified Defense with the target’s unmodified Defense; the value becomes the unmodified Defense for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Defense is averaged the same way.
Move_powersplit_Flavor: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
Move_powersplit_Effect:
Averages the user’s unmodified Attack with the target’s unmodified Attack; the value becomes the unmodified Attack for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Attack is averaged the same way.
This effect applies before any other persistent changes to unmodified Attack or Special Attack, such as flower gift during sunny day.
Move_wonderroom_Flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
Move_wonderroom_Effect: For five turns (including this one), every Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped.
Move_psyshock_Flavor: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
Move_psyshock_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.
Move_venoshock_Flavor: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
Move_venoshock_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is poisoned, this move has double power.
Move_autotomize_Flavor: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
Move_autotomize_Effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.  Halves the user’s weight; this effect does not stack.
Move_ragepowder_Flavor: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.
Move_ragepowder_Effect:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user.  If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.
This effect takes priority over lightning rod and storm drain.
If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with pursuit.
This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.
Move_telekinesis_Flavor: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
Move_telekinesis_Effect:
For three turns (including this one), moves used against the target have 100% accuracy, but the target is immune to ground damage.  Accuracy of one-hit KO moves is exempt from this effect.
This effect is removed by gravity.  If Gravity is already in effect, this move will fail.
Move_magicroom_Flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
Move_magicroom_Effect: For five turns (including this one), passive effects of held items are ignored, and Pokémon will not use their held items.
Move_smackdown_Flavor: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when it's hit.
Move_smackdown_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the target’s immunity to ground-type damage.  This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to levitate, magnet rise, or telekinesis, and causes the target’s flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage.
If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail.
This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of bounce, fly, or sky drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly.
Move_supersonic_Flavor: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

Move_partingshot_Effect: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage.  Makes the user switch out.
Move_topsyturvy_Flavor: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.
Move_drainingkiss_Flavor: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.
Move_drainingkiss_Effect: Deals regular damage.  Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Move_craftyshield_Flavor: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.
Move_craftyshield_Effect:
Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves for the rest of the turn.
Unlike other blocking moves, this move may be used consecutively without its chance of success falling.
Move_flowershield_Flavor: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.
Move_flowershield_Effect: Raises the Defense of all grass Pokémon in battle.
Move_icebeam_Flavor: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
Move_icebeam_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
Move_grassyterrain_Flavor: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.
Move_grassyterrain_Effect:
For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 their max HP each turn and strengthens their grass moves to 1.5× their power.
Changes nature power to energy ball.
Move_mistyterrain_Flavor: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.
Move_mistyterrain_Effect:
For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power.
Changes nature power to moonblast.
Move_electrify_Flavor: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target's move becomes Electric type.
Move_electrify_Effect: Changes the target’s move’s type to electric if it hasn’t moved yet this turn.
Move_playrough_Flavor: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
Move_playrough_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
Move_fairywind_Flavor: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.
Move_moonblast_Flavor: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_moonblast_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Move_boomburst_Flavor: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.
Move_fairylock_Flavor: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
Move_fairylock_Effect: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.
Move_kingsshield_Flavor: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also lowers the Attack stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
Move_kingsshield_Effect: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact.  Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.
Move_playnice_Flavor: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.
Move_playnice_Effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
Move_blizzard_Flavor: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
Move_blizzard_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
During hail, this move has 100% accuracy.  It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of protect and detect.
Move_confide_Flavor: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_confide_Effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Move_diamondstorm_Flavor: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage opposing Pokémon. This may also sharply raise the user's Defense stat.
Move_diamondstorm_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 50% chance to raise the user’s Defense by two stages for each target hit.
Move_steameruption_Flavor: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.
Move_steameruption_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to burn the target.
Move_hyperspacehole_Flavor: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. This also hits a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
Move_hyperspacehole_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.
Move_watershuriken_Flavor: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.
Move_mysticalfire_Flavor: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_mysticalfire_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 100% chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Move_spikyshield_Flavor: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.
Move_spikyshield_Effect: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.
Move_aromaticmist_Flavor: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
Move_aromaticmist_Effect: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.
Move_eerieimpulse_Flavor: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_eerieimpulse_Effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.
Move_venomdrench_Flavor: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
Move_venomdrench_Effect: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.
Move_payday_Flavor: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.
Move_payday_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  After the battle ends, the winner receives five times the user’s level in extra money for each time this move was used.
Move_psybeam_Flavor: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also leave the target confused.
Move_psybeam_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.
Move_powder_Flavor: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and damages the target.
Move_powder_Effect: Explodes if the target uses a fire move this turn, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP and preventing the move.
Move_geomancy_Flavor: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.
Move_geomancy_Effect: Takes one turn to charge, then raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages.
Move_magneticflux_Flavor: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which raises the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.
Move_magneticflux_Effect: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with plus or minus by one stage.
Move_happyhour_Flavor: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
Move_happyhour_Effect:
Doubles prize money.
Stacks with a held item.  Only works once per battle.
Move_electricterrain_Flavor: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.
Move_electricterrain_Effect:
For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their electric moves to 1.5× their power.
Changes nature power to thunderbolt.
Move_dazzlinggleam_Flavor: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
Move_celebrate_Flavor: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
Move_holdhands_Flavor: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
Move_babydolleyes_Flavor: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
Move_babydolleyes_Effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
Move_nuzzle_Flavor: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
Move_nuzzle_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.
Move_bubblebeam_Flavor: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.
Move_bubblebeam_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
Move_holdback_Flavor: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.
Move_holdback_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.
Move_infestation_Flavor: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
Move_infestation_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.
Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.
rapid spin cancels this effect.
Move_poweruppunch_Flavor: Striking opponents over and over makes the user's fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.
Move_poweruppunch_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
Move_oblivionwing_Flavor: The user absorbs its target's HP. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.
Move_oblivionwing_Effect: Deals regular damage.  Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Move_thousandarrows_Flavor: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.
Move_thousandarrows_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Grounds the target until it leaves battle.  Ignores levitation effects and the immunity of flying-type Pokémon.
Move_thousandwaves_Flavor: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can't flee from battle.
Move_thousandwaves_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Traps the target.
Move_landswrath_Flavor: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.
Move_lightofruin_Flavor: Drawing power from the Eternal Flower, the user fires a powerful beam of light. This also damages the user quite a lot.
Move_lightofruin_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
Move_originpulse_Flavor: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.
Move_precipiceblades_Flavor: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.
Move_aurorabeam_Flavor: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
Move_aurorabeam_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
Move_dragonascent_Flavor: After soaring upward, the user attacks its target by dropping out of the sky at high speeds. But it lowers its own Defense and Sp. Def stats in the process.
Move_dragonascent_Effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.
Move_hyperspacefury_Flavor: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. But the user's Defense stat falls.
Move_hyperspacefury_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.
Move_hyperbeam_Flavor: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
Move_hyperbeam_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.
Move_peck_Flavor: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
Move_drillpeck_Flavor: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.
Move_catastropika_Flavor: The user, Pikachu, surrounds itself with the maximum amount of electricity using its Z-Power and pounces on its target with full force.
Move_shoreup_Flavor: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.
Move_shoreup_Effect: Heals the user for ½ its max HP.  During a sandstorm, the healing is increased to ⅔.
Move_submission_Flavor: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.
Move_submission_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
Move_firstimpression_Flavor: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn each time the user enters battle.
Move_firstimpression_Effect: Inflicts regular damage. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.
Move_banefulbunker_Flavor: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.
Move_banefulbunker_Effect: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn.  If a Pokémon attempts to use a move that makes contact with the user, that Pokémon will be poisoned.  This move’s chance of success halves every time it’s used consecutively with any other protection move.
Move_spiritshackle_Flavor: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent the target from escaping.
Move_spiritshackle_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Traps the target.
Move_darkestlariat_Flavor: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect this attack's damage.
Move_darkestlariat_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.
Move_sparklingaria_Flavor: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be healed by the touch of these bubbles.
Move_sparklingaria_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has a burn and takes damage from this move, its burn is healed.
Move_icehammer_Flavor: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.
Move_icehammer_Effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.
Move_floralhealing_Flavor: The user restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP when the terrain is grass.
Move_floralhealing_Effect: Heals the target for ½ its max HP.  If grassy terrain is in effect, heals for ⅔ instead.
Move_highhorsepower_Flavor: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
Move_strengthsap_Flavor: The user restores its HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It also lowers the target's Attack stat.
Move_strengthsap_Effect:
Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.  Heals the user by the target’s current Attack, including modifiers, but not including this move’s Attack-lowering effect.
If the target’s Attack is already at -6, this move will fail.  In any other situation that would prevent a stat modification, the healing will still succeed.
Move_solarblade_Flavor: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light's energy, attacking the target on the next turn.
Move_solarblade_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User charges for one turn before attacking.
During sunny day, the charge turn is skipped.
During hail, rain dance, or sandstorm, power is halved.
This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.
Move_lowkick_Flavor: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
Move_lowkick_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.
Target’s weight | Power
--------------- | ----:
Up to 10kg      |    20
Up to 25kg      |    40
Up to 50kg      |    60
Up to 100kg     |    80
Up to 200kg     |   100
Above 200kg     |   120
Move_leafage_Flavor: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
Move_spotlight_Flavor: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked during the turn.
Move_spotlight_Effect: For the duration of the turn, if the target is also a valid target for a move used by one of its opponents, that move will target it instead.
Move_toxicthread_Flavor: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.
Move_toxicthread_Effect: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage.
Move_laserfocus_Flavor: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
Move_laserfocus_Effect: The user’s next move will result in a critical hit.
Move_gearup_Flavor: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.
Move_gearup_Effect: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all friendly Pokémon with plus or minus by one stage.
Move_throatchop_Flavor: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.
Move_throatchop_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Silences the target for two turns, preventing it from using any sound-based moves.
Move_pollenpuff_Flavor: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
Move_pollenpuff_Effect: If the target is an opponent, inflicts regular damage.  If the target is an ally, heals the target for 50% of its max HP.
Move_anchorshot_Flavor: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.
Move_anchorshot_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Traps the target.
Move_psychicterrain_Flavor: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
Move_psychicterrain_Effect:
Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns.  Overrides electric terrain, grassy terrain, and misty terrain.
All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0.  (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as spikes, are not affected.)  Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×.
If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.
Move_lunge_Flavor: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
Move_lunge_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
Move_counter_Flavor: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
Move_counter_Effect:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn.  Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user.  If there is no eligible target, this move will fail.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.
This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist or metronome.
Move_firelash_Flavor: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
Move_firelash_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
Move_powertrip_Flavor: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the move's power.
Move_powertrip_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised.  Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power.  For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.
Move_burnup_Flavor: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
Move_burnup_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the user’s fire type after damage calculation.  If the user is not fire-type, this move will fail.
Move_speedswap_Flavor: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
Move_speedswap_Effect: Exchanges the original Speed stats of the user and target.
Move_smartstrike_Flavor: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
Move_smartstrike_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
Move_purify_Flavor: The user heals the target's status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user's own HP.
Move_purify_Effect: Cures the target of its major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP.  If the target has no major status ailment, this move will fail.
Move_revelationdance_Flavor: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user's type determines the type of this move.
Move_revelationdance_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  This move’s type matches the user’s first type, if any; otherwise, it’s typeless.
Move_coreenforcer_Flavor: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.
Move_coreenforcer_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has already moved this turn, its ability is nullified.
Move_tropkick_Flavor: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
Move_tropkick_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
Move_instruct_Flavor: The user instructs the target to use the target's last move again.
Move_instruct_Effect: The target immediately uses its most recently-used move.  This is independent of the target’s normal action for the turn (i.e., it may end up moving twice), but otherwise functions as usual, including deduction of PP.  This effect works for disabled moves and ignores torment.
Move_seismictoss_Flavor: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
Move_seismictoss_Effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.
Move_beakblast_Flavor: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the Pokémon while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.
Move_beakblast_Effect: Begins charging at the start of the turn, then attacks as normal.  Any Pokémon that makes contact with the user while charging is burned.  The charging is not affected by accuracy, sleep, paralysis, or any other effect that would interfere with a move.
Move_clangingscales_Flavor: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat goes down after the attack.
Move_clangingscales_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage.
Move_dragonhammer_Flavor: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
Move_brutalswing_Flavor: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
Move_auroraveil_Flavor: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.
Move_auroraveil_Effect:
Places the Aurora Veil effect on the user’s side of the field for the next 5 turns.  If the weather is not hail, or the weather is disabled by the effects of cloud nine or air lock, this move will fail.
Any regular damage dealt to an affected Pokémon is reduced by ½.  (If there are multiple Pokémon on the affected field, the reduction is ⅓.)
Move_sinisterarrowraid_Flavor: The user, Decidueye, creates countless arrows using its Z-Power and shoots the target with full force.
Move_maliciousmoonsault_Flavor: The user, Incineroar, strengthens its body using its Z-Power and crashes into the target with full force.
Move_oceanicoperetta_Flavor: The user, Primarina, summons a massive amount of water using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force.
Move_guardianofalola_Flavor: The user, the Land Spirit Pokémon, obtains Alola's energy using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. This reduces the target's HP greatly.
Move_guardianofalola_Effect: Inflicts direct damage equal to ¾ of the target’s remaining HP.
Move_soulstealing7starstrike_Flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Marshadow, punches and kicks the target consecutively with full force.
Move_firepunch_Flavor: The target is punched with a fiery fist. This may also leave the target with a burn.
Move_firepunch_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
Move_strength_Flavor: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.
Move_stokedsparksurfer_Flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Alolan Raichu, attacks the target with full force. This move leaves the target with paralysis.
Move_stokedsparksurfer_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.
Move_pulverizingpancake_Flavor: Z-Power brings out the true capabilities of the user, Snorlax. The Pokémon moves its enormous body energetically and attacks the target with full force.
Move_extremeevoboost_Flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Eevee, gets energy from its evolved friends and boosts its stats sharply.
Move_extremeevoboost_Effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages each.
Move_genesissupernova_Flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mew, attacks the target with full force. The terrain will be charged with psychic energy.
Move_genesissupernova_Effect: Inflicts regular damage, then (if successful) changes the terrain to psychic terrain.
Move_shelltrap_Flavor: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on opposing Pokémon.
Move_shelltrap_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the user was not yet hit by an opponent’s physical move this turn, this move will fail.
Move_fleurcannon_Flavor: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_fleurcannon_Effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
Move_psychicfangs_Flavor: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.
Move_psychicfangs_Effect: Destroys any light screen or reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.
Move_stompingtantrum_Flavor: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user's previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.
Move_stompingtantrum_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.
Move_shadowbone_Flavor: The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
Move_shadowbone_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 20% chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
Move_accelerock_Flavor: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
Move_absorb_Flavor: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
Move_absorb_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Move_liquidation_Flavor: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
Move_liquidation_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 20% chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
Move_prismaticlaser_Flavor: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.
Move_prismaticlaser_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.
Move_spectralthief_Flavor: The user hides in the target's shadow, steals the target's stat boosts, and then attacks.
Move_spectralthief_Effect: Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts regular damage.  Will not steal stat increases that would put any of the user’s stats at more than +6; any excess is left on the target.  Stolen increases are affected by abilities as normal.
Move_sunsteelstrike_Flavor: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
Move_sunsteelstrike_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move.  In particular, it hits through disguise
Move_moongeistbeam_Flavor: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
Move_moongeistbeam_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move.  In particular, it hits through disguise
Move_tearfullook_Flavor: The user gets teary eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
Move_tearfullook_Effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.
Move_zingzap_Flavor: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target, giving it an electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
Move_zingzap_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Move_naturesmadness_Flavor: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.
Move_naturesmadness_Effect: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.
Move_multiattack_Flavor: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move's type.
Move_multiattack_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.
Note: This effect is technically shared by both techno blast and judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.
Move_10000000voltthunderbolt_Flavor: The user, Pikachu wearing a cap, powers up a jolt of electricity using its Z-Power and unleashes it. Critical hits land more easily.

Move_torchsong_Flavor: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
Move_aquastep_Flavor: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
Move_ragingbull_Flavor: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
Move_makeitrain_Flavor: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.
Move_hydrosteam_Flavor: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.
Move_ruination_Flavor: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target's HP in half.
Move_collisioncourse_Flavor: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.
Move_electrodrift_Flavor: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.
Move_rockthrow_Flavor: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.
Move_shedtail_Flavor: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
Move_chillyreception_Flavor: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.
Move_tidyup_Flavor: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user's Attack and Speed stats.
Move_snowscape_Flavor: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.
Move_pounce_Flavor: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
Move_trailblaze_Flavor: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
Move_chillingwater_Flavor: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
Move_hyperdrill_Flavor: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
Move_twinbeam_Flavor: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
Move_ragefist_Flavor: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
Move_earthquake_Flavor: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
Move_earthquake_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.
If the target is in the first turn of dig, this move will hit with double power.
Move_armorcannon_Flavor: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
Move_bitterblade_Flavor: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
Move_doubleshock_Flavor: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.
Move_gigatonhammer_Flavor: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.
Move_comeuppance_Flavor: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
Move_aquacutter_Flavor: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Move_blazingtorque_Flavor: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.
Move_wickedtorque_Flavor: Has a 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep.
Move_noxioustorque_Flavor: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
Move_combattorque_Flavor: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
Move_thunderpunch_Flavor: The target is punched with an electrified fist. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
Move_thunderpunch_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
Move_fissure_Flavor: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
Move_fissure_Effect:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.  This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target.  If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.
Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, endure still prevents the target from fainting.
The effects of lock on, mind reader, and no guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target.  However, they will not give this move a chance to break through detect or protect.
Move_magicaltorque_Flavor: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target.
Move_dig_Flavor: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.
Move_dig_Effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User digs underground for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.
During the immune turn, earthquake, fissure, and magnitude still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.
The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.
This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.
Move_upperhand_Flavor: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
Move_malignantchain_Flavor: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
Move_toxic_Flavor: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
Move_toxic_Effect: Badly poisons the target.  Never misses when used by a poison-type Pokémon.
Move_confusion_Flavor: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. This may also confuse the target.
Move_confusion_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.
Move_psychic_Flavor: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Move_psychic_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 10% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Move_hypnosis_Flavor: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.
Move_meditate_Flavor: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.
Move_meditate_Effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
Move_agility_Flavor: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.
Move_agility_Effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
Move_quickattack_Flavor: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This move always goes first.
Move_rage_Flavor: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.
Move_rage_Effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Every time the user is hit after it uses this move but before its next action, its Attack raises by one stage.
